headers.it: Hae cabu loe Jesu mah palung ih a hnukbang kami, patoeh ih kami ah kaom, Johan mah tarik (21.20, 24). Hae cabu loe A.D 90-100 salakah tarik mue, tiah poekhaih tawnh o. Hae Johan ih cabu thungah loe angmathaih sarihto lokpui koek ah amtuengsak. Cabu kroek kaminawk mah Jesu loe Messiah hoi Sithaw Capa ni (20.31) tiah panoek o thai hanah, hae angmathaihnawk hae amtuengsak ah oh. Tui misurtui ah angcoengsakhaih loe Jesu mah hmaloe koekah sak ih angmathaih ah oh (2. 11). Lazaru duekhaih thung hoi angthawksak lethaih loe hnukkhuem koekah sak ih angmathaih ah oh (11.43). Johan mah oepthok thoemto kaminawk hoi kaom tangtang Jesu kawng to kamtuengah thuih. To loknawk thungah koeh han koi kaom koek hmuen maeto loe a cabu amtonghaih lok ah kaom, ‘Hmaloe koekah Lok to oh, tangsuek naah Sithaw mah Lok hoiah long to sak, Lok loe takpum ah angcoeng, to takpum loe Jesu ni’ tiah thuih ih lok hae ni (1.3, 14).

verses.text: \s1 Lok to takpum ah angcoeng
Tangsuek naah Lok to oh, to Lok loe Sithaw hoi nawnto oh, Lok loe Sithaw ni.
Lok loe tangsuek na hoiah boeh ni Sithaw hoi nawnto oh.
Anih mah hmuennawk boih to sak; anih ai ah sak ih hmuen tidoeh om ai.
Anih thungah hinghaih oh; to hinghaih loe kami han aanghaih ah oh.

Aanghaih loe kaving thungah aang; toe kaving mah anih to panoek ai.   
\s1 Loktang aanghaih hnukung
\x - \xo 1:6 \xt Mathai 3.1; Mark 1.4; Luk 3.1,2.\x*Sithaw khae hoi patoeh ih kami maeto oh; anih ih ahmin loe Johan.
Anih rang hoiah kaminawk boih mah tanghaih tawnh o thai hanah, anih loe hnukung maeto ah oh moe, aanghaih hnukung ah oh hanah angzoh.
Anih loe to Aanghaih to na ai ni, toe to Aanghaih hnukung ah oh han ih ni patoeh.
To Aanghaih loe long nuiah angzo kaminawk boih aanghaih paekkung, Aanghaih tangtang ah oh.
Anih loe long ah oh, long loe Anih mah ni sak, toe long mah Anih to panoek ai.
Anih loe Angmah kaminawk khaeah angzoh, toe Angmah ih kaminawk mah Anih to talawk o ai.
Toe Anih talawk kaminawk hoi Anih ih ahmin tang kaminawk khaeah, Sithaw caa ah angcoeng thaihaih to a paek:

to caanawk loe athii, taksa hoi kami koehhaih baktiah tapen ai, Sithaw koehhaih baktiah tapen kami ah ni oh o.   
\s1 Lok loe taksa ah angcoeng
Lok loe takpum ah angcoeng, aicae salakah oh moe, tahmenhaih hoi loktang hoiah koi (Ampa mah maeto khue tawnh ih lensawkhaih,) a lensawkhaih to a hnuk o boeh.
Johan mah, Ka hnukah angzo kami loe kai tapen ai naah oh boeh, kai pongah len kue, tiah ka thuih ih lok loe Anih thuih koehhaih ih ni, tiah anih kawng to thuih.
Anih akoephaih hoi tahmenhaih loe aicae boih mah hnuk o.
Kaalok loe Mosi khaeah paek, toe tahmenhaih hoi loktang loe Jesu Kri rang hoiah ni angzoh.

Mi mah doeh Sithaw to hnu vai ai, toe Ampa ih saoek ah kaom, maeto khue tawnh ih, Capa mah Anih to amtuengsak boeh.   
\s1 Praezaek ih lok
Jerusalem ih Judahnawk mah, Nang loe mi aa? tiah dueng hanah qaimanawk hoi Levinawk to anih khaeah patoeh naah, Johan mah hae tiah thuih.
Anih loe angphat ai ah kai loe Kri na ai ni, tiah thuih.

\x - \xo 1:21 \xt Mal 4.5; \xt Deu 18.15,18.\x*Nihcae mah anih khaeah, to tih nahaeloe nang loe mi aa? Elijah maw? tiah dueng o. Anih mah, Kai loe Elijah na ai, tiah a naa. Nang loe Tahmaa maw? tiah dueng o. Anih mah, Kai loe tahmaa na ai ni, tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Kaicae patoeh kaminawk khaeah ka thuih pae o hanah nang loe mi aa, nangmah hoi nangmah to kawbangmaw na thuih? tiah a naa o.
\x - \xo 1:23 \xt Isaiah 40.3.\x*Anih mah, Tahmaa Isaiah mah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Kai loe Angraeng ih loklam to patoengh oh, tiah praezaek ah kahang kami ni, tiah a naa.
Nihcae loe Farasinawk mah ptoeh ih kami ah oh o.
Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Kri na ai, Elijah doeh na ai, Tahmaa doeh na ai to mah, tih han ih tuinuemhaih na paek loe? tiah dueng o.
Johan mah nihcae khaeah, Kai loe tui hoiah ni tuinuemhaih to ka paek: toe nangcae salakah kaom na panoek o ai ih kami maeto angdoet;
Anih loe ka hnukah angzoh, toe kai pongah len kue, kai loe anih ih khokpanai qui khram pae han mataeng doeh kam cuk ai, tiah a naa.

Hae hmuennawk loe Johan mah tuinuem paekhaih, Bethany avang Jordan vapui yaeh ah sak.   
\s1 Sithaw ih Tuucaa
Khawnbangah loe angmah khaeah kangzo Jesu to Johan mah hnuk, To naah khenah, long zaehaih phawkung, Sithaw Tuucaa! tiah thuih.
Anih loe kai tapen ai naah oh boeh, ka hnukah angzo kami loe kai pongah len kue, tiah ka thuih ih kami loe, Anih hae ni.
Anih to ka panoek ai: Anih loe Israel kaminawk khaeah amtueng han koi kami ah oh pongah, tui hoiah tuinuemhaih to ka paek, tiah a naa.
Johan mah, Pahuu baktiah van hoiah anghum tathuk, Anih nuiah kacuk, Muithla to ka hnuk, tiah thuih.

Anih to ka panoek ai: toe tui hoi tuinuem hanah kai patoehkung mah kai khaeah, Anih nuiah kacuk, anghum tathuk Muithla to na hnuk nahaeloe, Anih loe Kacai Muithla hoi tuinuem ih kami ah ni oh, tiah ang thuih.

Ka hnuk ih baktiah hae kami loe Sithaw Capa ni, tiah ka taphong boeh, tiah thuih.   
\s1 Andru hoi Piter kawkhaih
Khawnbangah Johan loe a hnukbang hnik hoi nawnto angdoet;
loklam ah kacaeh Jesu to a hnuk naah, Khenah, Sithaw Tuucaa! tiah thuih.
To lok to a hnukbang hnik mah thaih hoi naah, Jesu hnukah bang hoi ving.

Anih hnukah bang kami hnik to Jesu mah hnuk naah, angqoi moe, nihnik khaeah, \wj Timaw na pakrong hoi? \wj* tiah a naa. Nihnik mah anih khaeah, Rabbi, (Patukkung, tiah thuih koehhaih ih ni) naa ah maw na oh? tiah a naa hoi.

Anih mah nihnik khaeah, \wj Angzoh loe, khen hoih, \wj* tiah a naa. Nihnik loe caeh hoi moe, anih ohhaih ahmuen to khet hoi, to na ni loe Anih hoi nawnto oh hoi: to nathuem ah atue hato phak tom boeh.
Johan mah thuih ih lok thaih, Anih hnukah bang kami hnik thung ih maeto loe, Simon Piter ih amnawk Andru ni.
Andru loe amya Simon to pakrong hamloe moe, anih khaeah, Messiah (Kri, tiah thuih koehhaih ih ni) to ka hnuk o boeh, tiah a naa.

Anih mah amya to Jesu khaeah caeh haih. Jesu mah anih to khet moe, \wj Nang loe Jona capa Simon: Cepha \wj* (thlung, tiah thuih koehhaih ih ni,) \wj tiah kawk tih boeh, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Philip hoi Nathanael kawkhaih
Jesu loe khawnbangah Kalili ah caeh han amsak, Philip to a hnuk naah anih khaeah, \wj Ka hnukah bangah, \wj* tiah a naa.
Philip loe Andru hoi Piter baktih toengah Bethsaida vangpui ih kami ah oh.
Philip mah Nathanael to hnuk naah anih khaeah, Kaicae loe Mosi ih kaalok hoi tahmaanawk mah tarik ih, Joseph capa, Nazareth Jesu to ka hnuk o boeh, tiah a naa.
Nathanael mah anih khaeah, Nazareth hoiah hmuen kahoih tacawt thai tih maw? tiah a naa. Philip mah anih khaeah, Angzoh loe khen ah, tiah a naa.
Philip khaeah kangzo Nathanael to Jesu mah hnuk naah, anih khaeah, \wj Khenah, alinghaih tawn ai, Israel kami tangtang! \wj* tiah a naa.
Nathanael mah anih khaeah, Natuek naah maw kai nang panoek loe? tiah a naa. Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Philip mah na kawk ai vop, thaiduet kung tlim ah na oh naah, kang hnuk boeh, \wj* tiah a naa.
To naah Nathanael mah anih khaeah, Patukkung, Nang loe Sithaw Capa, Israel Siangpahrang ni, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Thaiduet kung tlim ah na oh naah, kang hnuk boeh, tiah kang naa pongah maw na tang? Hae pongah kalen kue hmuennawk to na hnu vop tih, \wj* tiah a naa.

\x - \xo 1:51 \xt Genesis 28.12.\x*Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Loktang to, loktang ah, Kang thuih o, Kam-ong van to na hnu o ueloe, Kami Capa nuiah daw tahang anghum tathuk Sithaw ih van kaminawk to na hnu o tih, \wj* tiah a naa.
Ni thumto naah Kalili prae Kana vangpui ah zu paluemhaih poih to oh; Jesu ih amno doeh toah oh toeng:
Jesu hoi a hnukbang kaminawk doeh to zu raenghaih poihkung ah kawk o toeng.
Misurtui boeng ving naah, Jesu amno mah Anih khaeah, Misurtui tawn o ai boeh, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, Nongpata nang hoi kai timaw asaenghaih oh? Kai ih atue pha ai vop, tiah a naa.
Amno mah tamnanawk khaeah, Ang thuih o ih lok baktiah sah oh, tiah a naa.
Judahnawk amprikcaihaih atawk baktih toengah, toah Kalan pumphaeto, to tih ai boeh loe quithumto akun, moiroih tarukto pahung o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Muiroih to tui pakoih oh, \wj* tiah a naa. Nihcae mah muroih koiah tui to thaeng o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Vaihi tui to buek oh loe, poih khawng kacoehta khaeah sin oh, \wj* tiah a naa. A thuih ih lok baktiah nihcae mah sak pae o.
Poih khawng kacoehta mah misurtui ah angcoengsak ih tui to pataeng naah, Naa ih maw lak o tito panoek ai: (toe tui doh tamnanawk mah loe panoek o;) poih khawngkung mah zu paluem kami to kawk,

anih khaeah, Kaminawk loe misur asing tui bae hmaloe ah patoem o; kaminawk paquih o boep tih naah ni, kahoih ai misurtui to paek o vop: toe nang loe vaihi khoek to maw misur asing tui na suek vop! tiah a naa.
Hae loe Jesu mah Kalili prae Kana vangpui ah sak tangsuek ih dawnrai hmuen ah oh moe, a lensawkhaih to amtuengsak; a hnukbang kaminawk mah Anih to tang o.

\x - \xo 2:12 \xt Mathai 4.13.\x*To pacoengah amno, nawkamyanawk, a hnukbang kaminawk hoi nawnto Kapernuam vangpui ah caeh o: to ah ni kasawk cam o ai.   
\s1 Tempul pasaehhaih
\x - \xo 2:13 \xt EXO 12.1-27.\x*Judahnawk ih misong loihhaih ni phak tom naah, Jesu loe Jerusalem ah caeh tahang,
tempul thungah maitaw, tuu, pahuu zaw kaminawk hoi phoisa athlaeng kaminawk to a hnuk:
Anih mah bohhaih qui tetta to sak moe, maitaw, tuu hoi to ih kaminawk to tempul thung hoiah haek boih; phoisa athlaeng kaminawk ih phoisa to kraih pae moe, caboinawk doeh pakhup pae boih;
pahuu zaw kaminawk khaeah, \wj Hae ahmuen hoiah hae hmuennawk hae la oh; kam Pa ih im hae hmuenmae zawhhaih im ah sah o hmah, \wj* tiah a naa.
\x - \xo 2:17 \xt Saam 69.9.\x*To naah a hnukbang kaminawk mah, Na im palunghaih mah Kai ang caak boih boeh, tiah tarik ih lok to poek o vawk.
To naah Judahnawk mah anih khaeah, Hae hmuennawk na sak naah, tih angmathaih maw kaicae han nang hnuksak? tiah dueng o.
\x - \xo 2:19 \xt Mathai 26.61; 27.40; Mark 14.58; 15.29.\x*Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Hae tempul hae phrae oh, ni thumto thungah ka padoet let han, \wj* tiah a naa.
To naah Judahnawk mah, Saning quipali, tarukto thung ka sak o ih, hae tempul hae nang mah ni thumto thungah na padoet let han maw? tiah a naa o.
Toe anih mah thuih koehhaih loe angmah ih takpum tempul to ni.
Anih duekhaih hoi angthawk let naah, a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah a thuih pae ih lok to panoek o let; to pongah nihcae loe Cabu hoi Jesu mah thuih ih lok to tang o.
Anih Jerusalem ih misong loihhaih poihkung ah oh naah, anih mah sak ih dawnrai hmuennawk to hnuk o, to naah paroeai kaminawk mah anih ih ahmin to tang o.
Toe Jesu mah kaminawk to panoek boih pongah, anih loe to kaminawk khaeah angmah hoi angmah to nihcae tlim ah angpaek ai.
Kami ih palungthin to anih mah panoek pongah, mi kawbaktih mah doeh anih hanah kami kawng thuih pae han angai ai.
Judah uk kaminawk thungah, Nicodemu, tiah ahmin kaom Farasi kami maeto oh:

anih loe qum ah Jesu khaeah caeh moe, anih khaeah, Rabbi, nang loe Sithaw khae hoi angzo patukkung ah na oh, tiah kang panoek o: Sithaw mah anih to om thuih ai nahaeloe, na sak ih dawnrai hmuennawk hae mi mah doeh sah thai mak ai, tiah a naa.

Jesu mah anih ih lok to pathim pae, anih khaeah, \wj Loktang to, loktang ah kang thuih, Mi kawbaktih doeh tapen let ai kami loe, Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah uk ih prae to hnu thai mak ai, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nikodemu mah anih khaeah, Kami loe mitong pacoengah kawbangmaw tapen let thai tih, anih loe amno zokthung ah vai hnetto akun ueloe, tapen let thai tih maw? tiah a naa.
Jesu mah, Loktang to, loktang ah kang thuih, \wj Tui hoi Muithla hoiah tapen ai kami loe, Sithaw prae thungah akun thai mak ai. \wj*
\wj Taksa ah tapen kami loe taksa ah oh; Muithla ah tapen kami loe muithla ah oh. \wj*
\wj Na tapen let han oh, tiah kang thuih pongah dawnrai hmah. \wj*
\wj Takhi loe a koeh baktiah song, takhi tuen to na thaih, toe naa bang hoiah maw angzoh moe, naa bangah maw caeh, tiah na thui thai ai: Muithla ah tapen kami loe to tiah oh, tiah a naa. \wj*
\wj Nikodemu mah anih khaeah, Hae hmuenawk loe kawbangmaw om thai tih? tiah pathim. \wj*
\wj Jesu mah anih khaeah, Israel kaminawk patukkung ah na oh to mah, hae hmuennawk hae na panoek ai maw? tiah a naa. \wj*
\wj Loktang to, loktang ah kang thuih, Kaicae loe panoek ih hmuen to ka thuih o moe, ka hnuk o ih hmuen to ni ka taphong o; ka taphong o ih hmuen to na talawk o ai. \wj*
\wj Long hmuen kawngnawk ka thuih naah mataeng doeh, na tang o ai nahaeloe, van hmuen kawngnawk ka thuih nahaeloe, kawbangmaw na tang o thai tih? \wj*
\wj Van hoi angzo tathuk, van ah kaom kami Capa ai ah loe, mi doeh van ah daw vai ai. \wj*
\x - \xo 3:14 \xt NAM 21.9.\x*\wj Mosi mah praezaek ah takhing ih pahui baktih toengah, kami Capa to takhing o tih. \wj*
\wj Mi kawbaktith doeh Anih tang kami loe anghmaa mak ai, dungzan hinghaih to hnu tih. \wj*
\wj Sithaw mah long palung phi pongah, maeto khue tawnh ih a Capa to a paek, mi kawbaktih doeh Anih tang kami loe anghmaa mak ai, dungzan hinghaih to hnu tih. \wj*
\wj Long lokcaek hanah Sithaw mah a Capa to long ah patoeh ai; Anih rang hoiah long pahlong han ih ni patoeh. \wj*
\wj Anih tang kami loe lokcaek mak ai, toe tang ai kami loe maeto khue tawnh ih Sithaw Capa ahmin to tang ai pongah, lokcaek ah oh boeh. \wj*
\wj Hae loe lokcaekhaih ah oh, aanghaih loe long ah angzoh, toe a sak o ih hmuennawk to hoih ai pongah, kaminawk mah aanghaih pongah vinghaih to koeh o kue. \wj*
\wj Kahoih ai hmuen sah kami loe aanghaih to hnukma, a toksakhaih amtueng moeng tih, tiah a poek pongah, aanghaih thungah angzoh han koeh ai. \wj*
\wj Toe loktang hoi kahing kami loe, Sithaw rang hoiah a sak o ih hmuennawk to amtueng thai hanah, aanghaih thungah angzoh, \wj* tiah a naa.
To pacoengah Jesu hoi a hnukbang kaminawk loe Judea prae ah caeh o; anih loe nihcae hoi nawnto to ahmuen ah oh moe, tuinuemhaih to paek.
Johan mah doeh Salim taengah kaom Aenon avang ah tuinuemhaih to paek: to ahmuen ah loe tui pop pongah, kaminawk angzoh o moe, tuinuemhaih to sak o.

\x - \xo 3:24 \xt Mathai 14.3; Mark 6.17; Luk 3.19,20.\x*To nathuem ah Johan loe thongim krah ai vop.   
\s1 Johan hoi Jesu
Ciimcaihaih kawng pongah Judahnawk hoi Johan hnukbang kaminawk lok angaek o.

Nihcae loe Johan khaeah caeh o moe, anih khaeah, Rabbi, khenah, Jordan vapui yaeh ah nang hoi nawnto kaom kami, na taphong ih kami mah tuinuemhaih to paek, kaminawk loe anih khaeah caeh o boih boeh, tiah a naa o.
Johan mah, Van hoiah anih han paek ai ah loe, kami mah tidoeh hnu thai mak ai.
\x - \xo 3:28 \xt Jhn 1.20.\x*Kai loe Kri na ai ni, toe kai loe Anih hmaa ah patoeh ih kami ni, tiah hnukung ah nangcae na oh o.

Zu lak naah nongpa mah ni nongpata to lak: toe zu kala thendoeng ih ampui loe anih taengah angdoet moe, anih ih lok to thaih, zu lakung ih lok to thaih pongah, paroeai anghoe: to pongah kang hoehaih loe hae tiah akoep boeh.
Anih loe pung tahang aep tih, toe kai loe amsah tathuk tih.
Van hoiah angzo kami loe hmuen boih ranui ah oh: long hoiah angcoeng kami loe long hmuen ah oh moe, long hmuen kawng to a thuih: van hoiah angzo kami loe hmuen boih ranui ah oh.
Anih mah loe hnuk moe, thaih ih hmuen to ni a thuih; mi mah doeh a thuih ih lok to talawk pae o ai.
A thuih ih lok talawk kami mah loe, Sithaw loe loktang ni, tiah catui to a daengh.
Sithaw mah patoeh ih kami loe Sithaw lok to thuih: Sithaw mah anih khaeah tahhaih om ai ah Muithla to paek.
\x - \xo 3:35 \xt Mathai 11.27; Luk 10.22.\x*Ampa mah Capa to palung pongah hmuennawk anih ban ah paek boih.
Capa tang kami loe dungzan hinghaih to tawnh: Capa tang ai kami loe hinghaih hnu mak ai; Sithaw palungphuihaih a nuiah om tih, tiah a naa.

1-2 (Jesu mah loe tuinuemhaih to paek ai, a hnukbang kaminawk mah ni paek o,) toe Jesu loe Johan pongah hnukbang kaminawk pop kue ah tawnh, kapop kue tuinuemhaih paek ti, tiah Farasinawk mah thaih o boeh, tiah Angraeng mah panoek naah,
Judea prae to tacawt taak moe, Kalili ah a caeh let.
To tiah a caeh naah Samaria prae thung hoiah caeh han angaih.
\x - \xo 4:5 \xt Genesis 33.19; Josh 24.32.\x*Anih loe caeh moe, Jacob mah a capa Joseph khaeah paek ih lawk taeng ih, Samaria prae thungah kaom Sikar, tiah kawk ih avang to phak.
To ahmuen ah loe Jacob mah takaeh ih tuikhaw to oh, Jesu loe kholong caeh angpho pongah tuikhaw nuiah anghnut: to naah atue tarukto thuemtham oh boeh.
Samaria nongpata maeto loe tuidok hanah angzoh: Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Naek han tui na paek ah, \wj* tiah a naa.
(A hnukbang kaminawk loe buh qan hanah avang ah caeh o.)

\x - \xo 4:9 \xt Ezr 4.1-5; Neh 4.1,2.\x*Samaria nongpata mah anih khaeah, Judah kami maeto ah na oh to mah, kawbangmaw Samaria nongpata, kai khaeah naek han tui nang hnik loe? Judahnawk loe Samari kaminawk hoi angkom o ai bae, tiah a naa.

Jesu mah nongpata khaeah, \wj Tui naek han na paek ah, tiah nang khaeah lokthui kami, Sithaw ih tangqum to na panoek soe nahaeloe, nang mah ni anih khaeah na hni ueloe, anih mah hinghaih tui to na paek tih, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nongpata mah anih khaeah, Patukkung, nang loe tui sohhaih tidoeh na tawn ai, tuikhaw loe thuk parai bae: to hinghaih tui loe naa hoiah maw na hnu tih?
Nang loe kaicae ampa Jakob pongah na len kue maw? Anih loe angmah doeh, a caanawk hoi a pacah ih moinawk mah doeh naek o ih, tuikhaw to kaicae hanah ang paek, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Mi kawbaktih doeh hae tui nae kami loe tui anghae let tih: \wj*

\wj toe mi kawbaktih doeh anih ka paek han koi tui nae kami loe, natuek naah doeh tui anghae mak ai boeh; anih ka paek han koi tui loe, anih thungah kalong dungzan kahing tuibap ah om tih, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nongpata mah anih khaeah, Patukkung, tui kang haeh han ai, haeah tuidok han ai ah, to tui to na paek khae, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Caeh ah loe, na sava to kawk pacoengah, haeah angzo ah, \wj* tiah a naa.
To naah nongpata mah, Sava ka tawn ai, tiah a naa. Jesu mah nongpata khaeah, \wj Sava ka tawn ai, tiah na thuih ih lok loe amsoem: \wj*
\wj sava pangato na tawnh boeh; vaihi na tawnh ih nongpa doeh na sava na ai ni: na thuih ih lok loe amsoem, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nongpata mah anih khaeah, Patukkung, nang loe tahmaa maeto ah na oh, tito kang panoek.
Kaicae ampanawk loe hae mae ah sithaw bok o; nangcae mah loe Jerusalem ah ni kaminawk mah Sithaw bok han oh, tiah na thuih o, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Nongpata, Kai hae na tang ah, hae mae ah na ai, Jerusalem ah doeh na ai ah, Pa na bok o haih atue to phak tom boeh. \wj*
\wj Nangcae loe na panoek o ai ih hmuen to na bok o: kaicae loe panoek ih hmuen to ni ka bok o: pahlonghaih loe Judahnawk ih ni. \wj*
\wj Toe Sithaw bok kaminawk mah Pa to Muithla hoi loktang ah bokhaih atue to pha tih, vaihi doeh phak boeh: Ampa loe to tiah Anih bok kaminawk to ni pakrong. \wj*

\wj Khrah palito pacoengah loe cang aah han khawt boeh, tiah na thuih o na ai maw? Khenah, kang thuih o, Mikpadai oh loe, lawknawk ho khen o noek ah; caang aah han hmin boeh. \wj*

\wj Tok na sah o ai ih lawk ah cang aah hanah kang patoeh o: kalah kaminawk mah toksak o, nangcae loe nihcae toksakhaih thungah na kun o, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Samaritan nongpata hoi lokramhaih
Nongpata mah, Ka sak ih hmuennawk ang thuih boih, tiah thuih pongah to avang thung ih paroeai Samaritan kaminawk mah Anih to tang o.
Samaritan kaminawk anih khaeah caeh o naah, nihcae khaeah cam pae hanah Anih to tahmenhaih hnik o, to pongah nihcae khaeah ni hnetto a cam pae.
Anih mah thuih ih lok pongah paroeai kaminawk mah tanghaih to tawnh o;

nihcae mah to nongpata khaeah, Nang mah thuih ih lok pongah na ai ni, kaimacae khaeh mah anih ih lok to ka thaih o moe, hae kami loe long pahlongkung, Kri ni, tiah ka panoek o pongah ni, vaihi ka tang o, tiah a naa o.

Natuek naah maw a capa ngantui let, tiah a dueng naah, Cangduem atue sarihto naah ngantui let, tiah a thuih pae o.

\s1 Sabbath niah ngantuisak
To pacoengah Judahnawk ih poih to oh; to naah Jesu loe Jerusalem ah caeh tahang.
Jerusalem vangpui ih tuu khongkha taengah, Hebru lok hoi Bethesda, tiah kawk ih tuili maeto oh, toah imphu kaom anghakhaih ahmuen pangato oh.
To ahmuen ah mikmaeng, khokkhaem, kangoi hoi nganna kaminawk angsong o mangh moe, kangphui tui to a zing o.
Atue atue naah van kami to angzoh tathuk moe, tui to angphuisak: mi kawbaktih doeh tui angphui naah lungpung hmaloe loe a tawnh ih kawbaktih nathaih doeh hoih.
To naah saning quithumto pacoeng, tazetto kangoi kami maeto tui taengah oh.
Jesu mah to kami loe saning paroeai kasawk ah to ahmuen ah angsong boeh, tito panoek naah, anih mah to kami khaeah, \wj Ngantui han na koeh maw? \wj* tiah a naa.
Nganna kami mah anih khaeah, Angraeng, tui angphui naah kai tui thungah va kami om ai: kang thawk moe, ka caeh li naah, kalah kaminawk ka hma ah lungpung o ving boeh, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Angthawk ah, nangmah ih nambaih to la ah loe, caeh laih, \wj* tiah a naa.
Akra ai ah to kami to ngantui roep, angmah ih kahni to lak moe, a caeh: to na ni loe Sabbath ah oh.
\x - \xo 5:10 \xt Neh 13.19; Jer 17.21.\x*To naah Judahnawk mah ngantui kami khaeah, Vaihni loe Sabbath niah oh: kahni lak han daan na ai ni, tiah a naa o.

To naah nihcae mah anih khaeah, Nangmah ih kahni to la ah loe, caeh laih, tiah thui kami loe mi aa? tiah dueng o.

To pacoengah Jesu mah anih to tempul thungah hnuk, anih khaeah, \wj Khenah, ngan na tui boeh: zaehaih sah let hmah lai ah, to tih ai nahaeloe kanung aep hmuen na nuiah pha tih, \wj* tiah a naa.
To kami loe caeh moe, anih ngantuisak kami loe Jesu ni, tiah Judahnawk khaeah thuih pae.
Jesu mah Sabbath niah to baktih hmuennawk sak pongah, Judahnawk mah Jesu to pacaekthlaek moe, hum hanah pacaeng o.
Toe Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Kam Pa loe vaihi khoek to toksak vop, to pongah kai doeh tok ka sak toeng,\wj* tiah a naa.

Anih loe Sabbath ni to zaa ai khue na ai ah, Sithaw loe Kam Pa ni, tiah thui moe, angmah hoi angmah to Sithaw hoi kangvan ah suek pongah, Judahnawk mah anih to hum hanah pacaeng o aep.   
\s1 Capa loe ampa hnukung ah oh

Jesu mah nihcae khaeah hae tiah lok pathim pae, \wj Loktang to, loktang ah, Kang thuih o, Ampa mah sak ih hmuen hnu ai ah, Capa loe angmah koeh ah tidoeh sah thai ai: ampa mah sak ih hmuennawk baktih toengah ni, Capa mah doeh sak toeng. \wj*
\wj Ampa mah Capa to palung pongah, a sak ih hmuennawk boih to anih hanah patuek: na dawnrai o hanah, hae hmuennawk pongah kalen kue anih han patuek vop tih. \wj*
\wj Ampa mah kadueh kaminawk to pathawk moe, nihcae han hinghaih paek baktih toengah, Capa mah doeh angmah koeh ih kaminawk khaeah hinghaih to paek. \wj*
\wj Ampa loe mi doeh lokcaek ai, lokcaekhaih to Capa khaeah paek boih boeh: \wj*
\wj Ampa to saiqat o baktih toengah, Capa to kami boih mah saiqat o thai hanah to tiah paek. A Capa saiqat ai kami loe, anih patoehkung ampa doeh saiqat ai. \wj*

\wj Loktang to, loktang ah, Kang thuih o, Ka lok hae tahngai moe, kai patoehkung Anih to tang kami loe, dungzan hinghaih to tawnh boeh pongah, lokcaekhaih tong mak ai; duekhaih thung hoiah a poeng boeh moe, hinghaih thungah akun boeh. \wj*
\wj Loktang to, loktang ah, Kang thuih o, Kadueh kaminawk mah Sithaw Capa ih lok to thai o tih: lok thaih kaminawk loe hing o tih, to baktih atue to angzo tih, vaihi doeh angzoh boeh. \wj*
\wj Ampa loe angmah ah hinghaih to tawnh boeh, to baktih toengah Capa mah doeh angmah ah hinghaih tawnh hanah ampa mah paek boeh. \wj*
\wj Anih loe Kami Capa ah oh pongah, lokcaek thaihaih doeh anih hanah paek boeh. \wj*
\wj Hae pongah dawnrai o sak hmah: taprong thung kaom kaminawk boih mah anih ih lok thaihaih atue to pha tih, \wj*

\s1 Ampa loe capa hnukung ah oh

\wj Kai loe kaimah koeh ah tidoeh sah thai ai: ka thaih ih baktih toengah lok ka caek: kaimah koehhaih to ka pakrong ai, kai patoehkung Pa koehhaih to ni ka pakrong, to pongah ka lokcaekhaih loe amsoem. \wj*
\wj Kaimah hoi kaimah hnukung ah ka oh nahaeloe, hnukung ah ka ohhaih to amsoem mak ai. \wj*
\wj Toe kai hnukung kalah maeto oh; anih mah kai hnukung ah ohhaih lok loe amsoem, tiah ka panoek. \wj*
\x - \xo 5:33 \xt Jhn 1.19-27; 3.27-30.\x*\wj Anih loe loktang hnukung ah oh pongah, Johan khaeah kami na patoeh o. \wj*

\x - \xo 5:37 \xt Mathai 3.17; Mark 1.11; Luk 3.22.\x*\wj Kai patoehkung, Pa loe kai hnukung ah oh. Nangcae mah loe anih ih lok to na thaih o vai ai, anih ih krang doeh na hnu o vai ai. \wj*
\wj Nangcae thungah anih ih lok om ai pongah, anih mah patoeh ih kami to na tang o ai. \wj*
\wj Nangcae dungzan hinghaih loe Cabu thungah oh, tiah na poek o pongah, Cabunawk to na khet o; to Cabunawk loe kai kawng thuikung ah ni oh o. \wj*
\wj Toe hinghaih na hnuk o hanah, kai khaeah angzoh han na koeh o ai. \wj*
\wj Toe nangcae thungah Sithaw amlunghaih om ai, tito ka panoek. \wj*

\wj Toe anih mah tarik ih loknawk to na tang o ai nahaeloe, kawbangmaw ka thuih ih loknawk to na tang o thai tih?\wj* tiah a naa.

\s1 Kami sang pangato pacah  
\r (Mathai 14.13-21; Marka 6.32-44; Luka 9.10-17)
To pacoengah Jesu loe Kalili tuipui yaeh ah kaom, Tiberia tuipui ah caeh.
Nathaih tawn kaminawk nuiah a sak ih dawnrai hmuen to hnuk o pongah, paroeai kaminawk anih hnukah bang o.
Jesu loe mae nuiah dawh moe, a hnukbang kaminawk hoi nawnto anghnut.
Judahnawk ih misong loihhaih poih loe, zoi boeh.
Jesu mah doeng tahang naah, anih khaeah angzo paroeai kaminawk to hnuk, to naah anih mah Philip khaeah, \wj Hae kaminawk caak o hanah naa ah maw takaw a qan o han?\wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah a sak han koi hmuen to panoek boeh, toe Philip to tanoek hanah hae lok hae a thuih.
Philip mah anih khaeah, denari cumvai hnetto tho takaw qan cadoeh nihcae han khawt mak ai, kami maeto mah zetta ni hak o tih, tiah a naa.
A hnukbang kami maeto, Simon Piter ih amnawk Andru mah, anih khaeah,
Barley cang hoi sak ih takaw pangato hoi tanga tetta katawn nawkta maeto haeah oh: toe kami hae zetto hanah loe tiah maw angcoeng tih? tiah a naa.
Jesu mah\wj kaminawk anghnu o sak ah,\wj* tiah a naa. To ahmuen loe paroeai phroh pop ahmuen ah oh. Sang pangato thuemtham kaom kaminawk loe phroh nuiah anghnut o.

Jesu mah takaw to lak moe, kawnhaih lawkthuih pacoengah, hnukbang kaminawk khaeah a paek; hnukbang kaminawk mah toah anghnu kaminawk hanah pazet pae o; to baktih toengah tanga doeh kaminawk zok amhah hanah a paek.

Kaminawk mah zok amhah ah caak o pacoengah, barley takaw pangato hoiah kamtlai caaknoinawk to a phrom o naah, benthang hatlai hnetto koi.

Jesu mah sak ih dawnrai hmuen to pop parai kaminawk mah hnuk o naah, Hae kami loe long nuiah angzo han koi Tahmaa tangtang boeh ni, tiah thuih o.   
\s1 Jesu tui nuiah caeh  
\r (Mathai 14.22-23; Marka 6.47-51)

palong thungah akun o moe, Kapernuam avang ah caeh o. Khoving boeh, toe Jesu loe nihcae khae pha ai vop.
Takhi sae song pongah tuiphu angthawk tahang.
Nihcae mah meng thumto maw, to tih ai boeh loe meng palito maw palong mong o pacoengah, palong ohhaih bangah tuipui nuiah kacaeh Jesu to nihcae mah hnuk o; nihcae loe zit o.

To pacoengah nihcae mah Anih to palong thungah akun o sak: akra ai ah palong hoiah caeh han amsak o ih ahmuen to a phak o.   
\s1 Jesu loe hinghaih takaw

Khawnbang phak naah, tuipui yaeh ah angdoe kaminawk loe a hnukbang kaminawk mah angthueng o ih palong khue ai ah loe, toah kalah palong om ai boeh, tito panoek o, a hnukbang kaminawk loe angmacae bueng ni caeh o, Jesu loe a hnukbang kaminawk hoi nawnto palong thungah akun ai;
(toe kalah palongnawk loe Angraeng mah kawnhaih lawkthuih pacoengah, nihcae takaw caakhaih ahmuen taengah Tiberia bang hoiah angzoh o:)
to ih kaminawk mah Jesu hoi a hnukbang kaminawk to ih ahmuen ah om o ai boeh, tiah panoek o naah, palong to angthueng o moe, Jesu pakrong hanah, Kapernuam vangpui bangah caeh o.
Nihcae mah tuipui yaeh ah Anih to hnuk o naah, nihcae mah anih khaeah, Rabbi, natuek naah haeah na phak loe? tiah dueng o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Loktang to, loktang ah, kang thuih o, dawnrai hmuennawk na hnuk o pong na ai ah, zok kamhah ah takaw na caak o pongah ni, kai nang pakrong o. \wj*
\wj Ampa Sithaw mah Anih nuiah catui daeng boeh pongah, Kamro koi buh hak hanah toksah o hmah, Kami Capa mah nangcae han paek han ih dungzan hinghaih hnuk hanah, tok to sah oh,\wj* tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Sithaw mah koeh ih tih tok maw ka sak o han? tiah dueng o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Anih mah patoeh ih Kami tang hae Sithaw ih tok boeh ni,\wj* tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Ka hnuk o moe, kang tang o hanah, kawbaktih angmathaih maw nang patuek han? Tih tok maw na sak han? tiah a naa o.

Nang loe kaicae ampa Abraham pongah na len kue maw? Anih loe duek boeh, tahmaanawk doeh duek o boeh: nangmah hoi nangmah to kawbangmaw na poek? tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah, \wj Kaimah hoi kaimah amkoeh nahaeloe, to tiah kam koehhaih to tiah doeh angcoeng mak ai: Anih loe kaicae ih Sithaw ni, tiah na thuih o ih, Kam Pa mah ni Kai hae ang pakoeh: \wj*

\wj Anih to na panoek o ai, toe kaimah loe Anih to panoek: Anih to Ka panoek ai, tiah Ka thuih nahaeloe, Kai doeh nangcae baktiah amsawnlok thui kami ah ni ka om tih: toe anih to ka panoek moe, a thuih ih lok to ka pakuem. \wj*
\wj Nangcae ampa Abraham loe Kai ih ani to hnuk hanah koeh parai: anih mah hnuk naah, paroeai anghoe,\wj* tiah pathim pae.
Judahnawk mah anih khaeah, Nang loe saning quipangato mataeng doeh akoep ai vop, Abraham to na hnuk maw? tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Loktang to, loktang ah, Kang thuih o, Abraham om ai naah, Ka oh boeh,\wj* tiah a naa.
To naah nihcae mah Anih vah hanah thlung akhui o: toe Jesu mah anghawk taak ving, paroeai kaminawk salakah a caeh moe, tempul thung hoiah tacawt ving.
\s1 Tapen tangsuek hoi mikmaeng hoisak
Jesu loe loklam ah caeh, to naah tapen tangsuek hoi mikmaeng kami to a hnuk.
A hnukbang kaminawk mah anih khaeah, Rabbi, hae kami loe angmah ih zaehaih pongah maw, to tih ai boeh loe amno ampanawk zaehaih pongah maw mik maengh? tiah dueng o.
Jesu mah, \wj Angmah zaehaih pongah na ai, amno ampanawk zaehaih pongah doeh na ai: toe anih khaeah Sithaw toksakhaih to amtueng tih. \wj*
\wj Khodai naah kai patoehkung ih tok to ka sak han oh: khoving naah loe mi doeh toksah thai mak ai. \wj*
\x - \xo 9:5 \xt Mathai 5.14; Jhn 8.12.\x*\wj Kia long ah ka oh nathung, kai loe long aanghaih ah ka oh,\wj* tiah a naa.
Hae loknawk a thuih pacoengah, anih mah long ah tamtui pathoih moe, long to tamtui hoiah kanaem ah pathluem; to pacoengah mikmaeng ih mik to long kanaem hoiah a nok pae,
\wj caeh ah loe kangbuem Siloam tuili\wj* (thuih koehhaih loe patoeh tih haih ih ni) \wj ah amsae ah,\wj* tiah a naa.
Imtaeng kaminawk hoi anih loe mikmaeng ni, tiah hnuzong kaminawk mah, Hae kami loe anghnut moe, minawk khaeah ban patueng kami na ai maw? tiah thuih o.
Thoemto kaminawk mah, Hae kami loe anih to ni, tiah thuih o, kalah thoemto kaminawk mah loe, Hae kami loe anih hoiah anghmong, tiah thuih o: toe mikmaeng mah to kami loe kai ni, tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Kawbangmaw na mik amtueng? tiah a naa o.

Anih mah, Jesu, tiah kawk ih kami mah long to kanaem ah pathluem moe, ka mik ah ang nok pae, to pacoengah kangbuem Siloam tuili ah amsaeh hanah ang thuih; ka caeh moe, kam saeh naah, ka mik hae amtueng, tiah pathim pae.
Nihcae mah anih khaeah, To kami loe naa ah maw oh? tiah dueng o. Anih mah, Ka panoek ai, tiah a naa.
Sabbath niah Jesu mah long to kanaem ah pathluem moe, mikmaeng to ngantuisak.
Farasinawk mah doeh na mik loe kawbangmaw amtueng, tiah dueng o. Anih mah nihcae khaeah, Anih mah long kanaem to ka mik ah ang nok pae, tui hoiah mik ka pasaeh naah, ka mik hae amtueng, tiah a naa.

To naah thoemto Farasinawk mah, Hae kami loe Sabbath ni za ai pongah, Sithaw khae ih kami na ai ni, tiah thuih o. Kalah kaminawk mah loe, Kazae kami mah kawbangmaw hae baktih dawnrai hmuennawk to sah tih, tiah a naa o. To pongah maeto hoi maeto ampraek o.
Nihcae mah mikmaeng khaeah, Na mik amtuengsak kami to kawbangmaw na poek? tiah dueng o let. To naah anih mah, To kami loe Tahmaa ni, tiah a naa.
Toe Judahnawk mah hae kami loe mikmaengh, toe vaihi loe mik amtueng boeh, tito mik amtueng kami ih amno hoi ampa kawk ai karoek to tang o ai.
Nihcae mah to kami ih amno hoi ampa khaeah, Anih loe tapen tangsuek nathuem hoiah mik a maeng boeh, tiah na thuih hoi ih nanghnik ih capa maw? Kawbangmaw vaihi anih ih mik amtueng pae? tiah dueng o.
Anih ih amno hoi ampa mah nihcae khaeah, Hae kami loe kaihnik ih capa ni, anih loe tapen tangsuek na hoiah mikmaeng boeh:

toe kawbangmaw vaihi a mik amtueng pae let, mi mah maw a mik amtuengsak, tito ka panoek hoi ai: anih loe saning akoep boeh: to pongah angmah khaeah dueng oh: anih mah angmah kawng to thui tih hmang, tiah a naa hoi.
Mi kawbaktih doeh Anih loe Kri ni, tiah thui kami loe sineko hoiah pathok si, tiah Judahnawk palung adue o; Judah kaminawk to a zit hoi pongah ni, anih ih amno hoi ampa mah to tiah lokthuih hoi.
To pongah, anih ih amno hoi ampa mah anih loe saning akoep boeh; angmah khaeah dueng oh, tiah a thuih pae hoi.
Nihcae mah mikmaeng to kawk o let moe, anih khaeah, Sithaw to mah pakoeh ah: hae kami loe kami zae, tiah ni ka panoek o, tiah a naa o.
Anih mah, Hae kami loe kami zae maw, kami zae ai, tito ka panoek ai: hmuen maeto ka panoek ih oh, kai loe canghniah mik ka maengh, toe vaihi loe mik amtueng boeh, tiah a naa.
To naah nihcae mah anih khaeah, Anih mah tih maw ang sak pae? Anih mah na mik to kawbangmaw amtuengsak? tiah dueng o let.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, Kang thui o boeh, toe na tahngai o ai: tikhoe thaih let han na koeh o loe? Nangcae doeh Anih hnukbang kami ah oh hanah na koeh o maw? tiah a naa.
To naah nihcae mah anih to zoeh o, Nang loe Anih hnukbang kami ah na oh, toe kaicae loe Mosi hnukbang kami ah ni ka oh o.
Sithaw mah Mosi khaeah ni lokthuih pae, tito ka panoek o: toe hae kami loe naa ih kami maw, tito ka panoek o ai, tiah a naa o.
To kami mah nihcae khaeah, Dawnrai han oh, Anih loe naa ih kami maw, tito na panoek o ai, toe anih mah ni ka mik hae amtuengsak.
Sithaw mah kami zaenawk ih lok tahngai ai, tito a panoek o: toe Sithaw to bok moe, a koehhaih sah kami ih lok loe, Anih mah tahngai pae.
Tapen tangsuek na hoi kaom mikmaeng to mik amtuengsak, tiah long oh tangsuek na hoi mi mah doeh thai vai ai vop.
Hae kami loe Sithaw ih kami ai nahaeloe, anih mah tidoeh sah thai mak ai, tiah a naa.

Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Kami zae ah tapen nang mah kaicae hae nang patuk maw? tiah a naa o. Anih to tasa bangah pathok o ving.   
\s1 Jesu hoi ngantui kami lok apaehhaih
Nihcae mah mikmaeng to haek o ving, tiah Jesu mah thaih; Jesu mah mikmaeng to hnuk naah, anih khaeah, \wj Kami Capa to na tang maw?\wj* tiah a naa.
To naah mikmaeng mah Jesu khaeah, Angraeng, Anih to ka tang thai hanah, Anih loe mi maw? tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah\wj Anih to na hnuk boeh bae, nang hoi lokpae kami loe anih to boeh ni,\wj* tiah a naa.
To naah mikmaeng mah, Angraeng, Ka tang, tiah thuih moe, Anih to a bok.
Jesu mah, \wj Kai loe mikmaengnawk mik amtuengsak moe, mik amtueng kaminawk mikmaengsak han hoi lokcaek han ih ni hae long nuiah kang zoh,\wj* tiah a naa.
Anih khae kaom thoemto Farasinawk mah to loknawk to thaih o naah, anih khaeah, Kaicae doeh mik ka maengh o maw? tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Mik na maeng o nahaeloe, zaehaih na tawn o mak ai: toe kaicae loe mik amtueng, tiah vaihi na thuih o pongah, zaehaih na tawnh o,\wj* tiah a naa.
\wj Loktang to, loktang ah, kang thuih o, Tuu khongkha thung hoi akun ai, kalah loklam hoiah daw tahang kami loe, kamqu hoi mingcahnawk ni. \wj*
\wj Toe tuutoep kami loe tuu khongkha thung hoiah ni akunh. \wj*
\wj Khongkha toep kami mah anih hanah thok to paongh pae; tuunawk mah anih ih lok to tahngai pae o: anih loe angmah ih tuunawk to ahmin hoiah kawk moe, tasa bangah caeh haih. \wj*
\wj A tuunawk tasa bangah caeh haih naah, nihcae hmaa ah a caeh pae, tuunawk mah anih ih lok to maat o pongah, anih hnukah bang o. \wj*
\wj Tuunawk loe hnuk vai ai ih kami hnukah natuek naah doeh bang o mak ai, a lok to maat o ai pongah, cawn o taak tih,\wj* tiah a naa.

Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, Hae patahhaih lok hae a thuih pae, toe nihcae khaeah a thuih pae ih lok to nihcae mah thaih pae o kop ai.   
\s1 Kahoih tuutoepkung Jesu
To pacoengah Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Loktang to, loktang ah, kang thuih o, Kai loe tuu khongkha ah ka oh. \wj*
\wj Kai hmaa ah angzo kaminawk boih loe kamqu hoi mingcahnawk ni: tuunawk mah nihcae ih lok to tahngai pae o ai. \wj*
\wj Kai loe khongkha ah ka oh: mi kawbaktih doeh kai thung hoiah akun kami loe, pahlonghaih hnu tih, a thungah caeh ueloe, tacawt tih, to pacoengah rawkcak caakhaih kahoih ahmuen to hnu tih. \wj*
\wj Kamqu loe paquk han ih, hum han ih hoi paro han ih ni angzoh: Kai loe nihcae hinghaih tawnh o moe, pop aep ah a tawnh o han ih ni kang zoh. \wj*
\wj Kai loe kahoih tuutoepkung ah ka oh: kahoih tuutoepkung loe tuunawk hanah a hinghaih to paek. \wj*
\wj Tuutoep kami ai, tuu tawnkung doeh na ai, thlai ih kami loe kangzo tasui to hnuk naah, tuunawk to prawtsut moe, cawnh taak ving: tasui mah tuunawk to kaek moe, tuunawk to ampraeksak phang. \wj*
\wj Thlai ih kami loe thlai ih kami ah oh pongah, tuunawk to dawncang ai. \wj*
\x - \xo 10:14 \xt Mathai 11.27; Luk 10.22.\x*\wj Kai loe kahoih tuutoepkung ah ka oh; Kai mah ih tuunawk to Ka panoek, tuunawk mah doeh kai ang panoek o. \wj*
\wj Pa mah Kai ang panoek baktih toengah, Pa to Ka panoek, Ka hinghaih to tuunawk hanah ka paek. \wj*

\wj Hae tuu khongkha thungah kathum ai, kalah tuunawk doeh Ka tawnh: nihcae doeh Ka hoih han oh vop, nihcae mah ka lok to tahngai o tih; to pacoengah loe tuu khongkha maeto hoi tuutoepkung maeto ni om tih boeh. \wj*
\wj Ka hinghaih ka paek pongah, Kam Pa mah Kai ang palung, to hinghaih to ka lak let han. \wj*

\wj Mi mah doeh kai khae hoi lomh mak ai, Kaimah koehah ni hinghaih to ka paek. Ka paek thaih baktih toengah, lak let thaihaih doeh ka tawnh. Kam Pa khae hoiah ni hae lokpaekhaih hae Ka hnuk,\wj* tiah a naa.
Hae a thuih ih loknawk pongah Judah kaminawk salakah ampraekhaih to oh let.
Paroeai kaminawk mah, Anih loe taqawk tawnh moe, amthu boeh; tih hanah a lok to na tahngai pae o khing loe? tiah naa o.

Kalah kaminawk mah loe, Hae loknawk loe taqawk tawn kami mah thuih ih lok na ai ni. Taqawk mah loe mikmaeng to mik amtuengsak thai tih maw? tiah thuih o.   
\s1 Tuutoepkung mah angmah ih tuunawk to panoek
Siktue phak naah loe, Jerusalem ah angpaekhaih poih to oh.
Jesu loe tempul thung ih Solomon impoem ta ah amkaeh.
To naah Judahnawk mah anih to takui o moe, anih khaeah, Nasetto maw kaicae palung nang haengsak han vop? Kri ah na oh nahaeloe, kamnoek ah na thui ah, tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Kang thuih o boeh, toe nang tang o ai: Kam Pa ih ahmin hoiah ka sak ih toknawk loe, Kai hnukung ah oh o. \wj*
\wj Toe kang thuih o baktiah, Kai ih tuu ah na om o ai pongah, Kang thuih o ih lok to na tang o ai. \wj*
\wj Kai ih tuunawk loe Ka lok to tahngai o, nihcae to Ka panoek, nihcae loe Ka hnukah bang o. \wj*
\wj Dungzan hinghaih to nihcae hanah ka paek; nihcae loe natuek naah doeh anghmaa o mak ai, mi mah doeh Ka ban thung hoiah lomh mak ai. \wj*
\wj Nihcae kai khaeah paekkung, Kam Pa loe, tih boih pongah len kue; mi mah doeh nihcae to Kam Pa ban thung hoiah lomh thai mak ai. \wj*

\wj Kai hoi Kam Pa loe maeto ni,\wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Jesu vah hanah thlung akhui o
To naah Judahnawk mah Anih vah hanah thlung akhui o let.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Kam Pa khae hoi ih paroeai kahoih toknawk to kang patuek o boeh; kawbaktih tok pongah maw Kai thlung hoiah nang va o han?\wj* tiah a naa.

\x - \xo 10:33 \xt LEV 24.16.\x*Judahnawk mah anih khaeah, Kahoih tok pongah thlung hoi kang va o mak ai; toe nang loe Sithaw ih ahmin kasae na thuih; kami ah na oh to mah, nangmah hoi nangmah to Sithaw ah nang sak pongah ni, tiah a naa o.
\x - \xo 10:34 \xt Saam 82.6.\x*Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Nangcae loe sithawnawk ah na oh o, tiah Ka thuih, tiah nangmacae ih kaalok thungah tarik ih lok to oh na ai maw? \wj*
\wj Anih mah nihcae to sithawnawk, tiah kawk nahaeloe, mi khaeah maw Sithaw lok to angzoh, Cabu loe amro thai mak ai; \wj*
\wj ampa mah ciimcaisak moe, long nuiah patoeh ih kami mah, Kai loe Sithaw Capa ah ka oh, tiah Ka thuih pongah maw, Sithaw ih ahmin kasae na thuih, tiah nang naa o? \wj*
\wj Kam Pa ih tok to ka sah ai nahaeloe, na tang o hmah. \wj*

\wj Toe a tok to ka sak pae nahaeloe, Kai nang tang o ai cadoeh, ka sak ih toknawk to tang oh; to tiah nahaeloe Pa Kai thungah oh moe, Kai doeh Anih thungah ka oh, tito na panoek o thai tih,\wj* tiah a naa.

To pongah nihcae mah Anih naeh hanah pakrong o let: toe Anih loe nihcae ban thung hoiah loih.   
\s1 Jesu Jordan vapui yaeh ah caeh
\x - \xo 10:40 \xt Jhn 1.28.\x*Anih loe Johan mah tuinuem paek tangsuekhaih Jordan vapui yaeh ah caeh moe, toah oh.
To pacoengah paroeai kaminawk anih khaeah angzoh o moe, Johan loe dawnrai hmuen sah vai ai: toe Johan mah thuih ih hae kami kawngnawk boih loe amsoem, tiah a thuih o.
\s1 Lazaru duekhaih lok Jesu mah thaih
\x - \xo 11:1 \xt Luk 10.38,39.\x*Lazaru, tiah kawk ih kami loe ngannat, anih loe Meri hoi amnawk Martha ohhaih Bethani avang ih kami ah oh.
\x - \xo 11:2 \xt Jhn 12.3.\x*(To Meri loe nganna Lazaru ih tanuh ah oh moe, Angraeng ih khok to hmuihoih tui hoiah bawh moe, a sam hoiah anih ih khok hmawt pae kami ah oh.)
To pongah a tanuh hnik mah Anih khaeah, Angraeng, khenah, na palung ih kami loe ngannat, tiah lok a pat pae hoi.

To lok to Jesu mah thaih naah, \wj Hae nathaih loe duek han khoek to om ai, toe Sithaw lensawkhaih amtueng han ih ni oh, hae nathaih rang hoiah lensawk Sithaw Capa amtuenghaih to om tih,\wj* tiah a naa.
Jesu mah Martha, anih ih amnawk hoi Lazaru to palung.
Lazaru ngannat ti, tiah Anih mah thaih pacoengah, anih loe a ohhaih ahmuen ah ni hnetto thung cam vop.
To pacoengah a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah, \wj Jerusalem ah caeh o let si boeh,\wj* tiah a naa.
A hnukbang kaminawk mah Anih khaeah, Rabbi, canghni pangah ni Judahnawk mah thlung hoi vah hanah Ang pakrong o; to ahmuen ah Na caeh let han maw? tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah, \wj Nito naah atue hatlai hnetto om ai maw? Mi kawbaktih doeh khodai ah caeh kami loe, hae long aanghaih to a hnuk pongah amthaek ai. \wj*
\wj Toe khoving ah caeh kami loe, aanghaih om ai pongah, amthaek,\wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, Hae loknawk thuih pacoengah, \wj Aicae ampui Lazaru loe a iih; toe Ka caeh moe, Ka pathawk han,\wj* tiah a naa.
Anih hnukbang kaminawk mah, Angraeng, anih iip nahaeloe hoi tih, tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah Lazaru loe duek boeh, tiah thuih koehhaih ih ni, toe nihcae mah loe iih rumramhaih mue a thuih, tiah poek o.
To pacoengah Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Lazaru loe duek boeh, tiah kamnoek ah thuih pae. \wj*
\wj Na tang o thai hanah, to ahmuen ah ka om ai pongah, nangcae hanah anghoehaih ka tawnh; vaihi anih khaeah caeh o si, \wj* tiah a naa.

To naah Didymas, tiah kawk ih, Thomas mah a hnukbang ampuinawk khaeah, aicae doeh anih hoi nawnto duek hanah caeh o toeng si, tiah a naa.   
\s1 Jesu loe angthawkhaih hoi hinghaih
Jesu phak naah, anih aphumhaih ni palito oh boeh, tito Anih mah panoek.
Bethani loe Jerusalem hoiah meng hnetto oh duih.
Nihnik ih thangqoi to duek pae boeh pongah, pathloep hanah paroeai Judahnawk Martha hoi Meri khaeah caeh o.
Jesu angzoh ti, tiah Martha mah thaih naah, Anih dawt hanah a caeh: toe Meri loe im ah oh.
Martha mah Jesu khaeah, Angraeng, haeah na oh nahaeloe, ka thangqoi hae dueh mak ai.
Toe vaihi doeh Sithaw khaeah na hnik ih hmuen boih loe, Sithaw mah na paek tih, tiah ka panoek, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah nongpata khaeah, \wj Na thangqoi loe angthawk let tih,\wj* tiah a naa.
Martha mah anih khaeah, Hnukkhuem angthawk lethaih niah loe anih angthawk let tih, tiah ka panoek, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Kai loe angthawk lethaih hoi hinghaih ah Ka oh: Kai tang kami loe, dueh cadoeh, hing tih: \wj*
\wj mi kawbaktih doeh Kai tanghaih hoiah khosah kami loe natuek naah doeh dueh mak ai. Hae lok hae na tang maw?\wj* tiah a naa.

Nongpata mah Anih khaeah, Ue, Angraeng: Nang loe Kri ni, long nuiah angzo han koi, Sithaw Capa ah na oh, tito Ka tang, tiah a naa.   
\s1 Jesu hoi duekhaih kawng
To tiah lok cae a thuih pacoengah, Martha loe caeh moe, tamquta hoi amnawk Meri to kawk, Patukkung, angzoh boeh, nang ang kawksak, tiah a naa.
Meri mah to lok to thaih naah, karangah angthawk moe, Anih khaeah caeh.
To naah Jesu loe avang thungah akun ai vop, Anih loe Martha mah dawthaih ahmuen ah ni oh vop.
Meri pathloep hanah im ah kangzo Judahnawk loe, karangah angthawk o moe, tasa bangah tacawt Meri to hnuk o naah, qah han ih mue taprong ah a caeh, tiah poek o pongah, anih hnukah bang o.
Meri loe Jesu ohhaih ahmuen to phak moe, Anih to hnuk naah, a khokkung ah cangkrawn moe, Anih khaeah, Angraeng, haeah na oh nahaeloe, ka thangqoi hae dueh mak ai, tiah a naa.
Anih qahhaih hoi anih hoi nawnto kangzo Judahnawk qahhaih to Jesu mah hnuk naah, palungset moe, poek angpho,
\wj anih mah naa ah maw a qok to na pasong o?\wj* tiah a naa. Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Angraeng, angzo ah loe khenah, tiah a naa o.
Judah kaminawk mah, Khen oh, Anih mah kawkrukmaw Lazaru to palung, tiah thuih o.

Nihcae thung ih thoemto kaminawk mah, Mikmaeng mik amtuengsak, hae kami mah Lazaru duek han ai ah sah thai mak ai maw? tiah thuih o.   
\s1 Jesu mah Lazaru pathawk
To pongah Jesu loe palungset hoiah taprong ah caeh. Taprong loe thlung khaw ah oh pongah, akhaw to thlung hoiah kraeng o.
Jesu mah, \wj Thlung to takhoe oh,\wj* tiah a naa. Toe kadueh kami ih tanuh Martha mah, Anih khaeah, Vaihi loe anih ih qok hmuisae tih boeh, aphumhaih ni palito oh boeh, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, Na tang nahaeloe, Sithaw lensawkhaih na hnu tih, tiah kang thuih boeh na ai maw? tiah a naa.
To naah qok pasonghaih taprong thlung to takhoe pae o. Jesu mah van ah doeng tahang moe, \wj Pa, Ka lok nang tahngaih pae pongah, kawnhaih lok kang thuih. \wj*
\wj Ka lok nang tahngaih pae toepsoep, tiah ka panoek: toe haeah angdoe kaminawk mah, Kai loe Nang mah ni patoeh, tiah tang o thai han ih ni, hae lok hae ka thuih,\wj* tiah a naa.
Hae lok a thuih pacoengah, \wj Lazaru, tacawt ah,\wj* tiah tha hoi a hang.

To naah kadueh kami to tacawt, a ban hoi a khok loe kadueh khukhaih kahni mah zaeng caeng: mikhmai doeh pavawh mah khuk khoep. Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Anih to khram oh, caeh nasoe,\wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Jesu hum han patoem o  
\r (Mathai 26.1-5; Marka 14.1-2; Luka 22.1-2)
Jesu mah sak ih hmuen to, Meri pathloep han angzo paroeai Judahnawk mah hnuk o naah, Anih to tang o.
Toe nihcae thung ih thoemto kaminawk loe Farasinawk khaeah caeh o moe, Jesu mah sak ih hmuennawk to thuih pae o.

Judahnawk misong loihaih poih loe anghnai boeh: to poih sah ai naah, amprikcai o hanah, paroeai kaminawk loe angmacae avang hoiah Jerusalem ah caeh o.
Nihcae mah Jesu to pakrong o, nihcae tempul thungah angdoet o naah, kawbangmaw na poek o? Anih poihkung ah angzo mak ai maw? tiah maeto hoi maeto angdueng o.
Kalen koek qaima hoi Farasinawk mah, Mi kawbaktih doeh Anih ohhaih panoek kami loe, Anih to a naeh o thai hanah, a ohhaih ahmuen to patuek han angaih, tiah lokpaek o.

to kaminawk loe Kalili prae Bethsaida avang ah om kami, Philip khaeah angzoh o moe, Patukkung, Jesu hnuk han ka koeh o, tiah tahmenhaih hnik o.

Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Kami Capa pakoehhaih atue loe phak boeh. \wj*
\wj Loktang to, loktang ah, kang thuih o, Cangti loe long ah krak moe, dueh ai nahaeloe, angmah toengroeng ah ni oh: toe a duek naah loe, athaih paroeai athaih. \wj*

\x - \xo 12:25 \xt Mathai 10.39; 16.25; Mark 8.35; Luk 9.24; 17.33.\x*\wj Mi kawbaktih doeh a hinghaih palung kami loe, anghmaa tih; hae long nuiah a hinghaih hnuma kami loe dungzan hinghaih to toep tih. \wj*

\wj Pa, na hmin to pakoeh ah,\wj* tiah a naa. To naah van hoiah, Ka pakoeh hmaek boeh, Ka pakoeh let han vop, tiah lok to angzoh.

\x - \xo 12:34 \xt Saam 110.4; Isaiah 9.7; Ezek 37.25; Dan 7.14.\x*To naah paroeai kaminawk mah anih khaeah, Kri loe dungzan ah caak poe tih, tiah kaalok mah thuih ih lok to ka thaih o: nangmah loe kawbangmaw, Kami Capa to ranui ah bang o tih, tiah na thuih, hae Kami Capa loe mi maw? tiah pathim pae o.

\wj Kai talawk ai moe, ka lok tahngai ai kami lokcaekkung maeto oh: Ka thuih ih lok mah anih to hnukkhuem niah lokcaek tih. \wj*
\wj Kai loe kaimah koehah lok ka thui ai; toe ka thuih moe, ka patuk han ih lok loe kai patoehkung Pa mah ni ang paek. \wj*

\s1 Hnukbang kaminawk ih khok pasaeh pae

Misong loihhaih poih pha ai vop, Jesu mah hae long tacawt taak moe, Ampa khaeah caehhaih atue phak boeh, tiah panoek naah, long ah kaom angmah ih kaminawk khaeah, atue boeng khoek to amlunghaih to amtuengsak.
Duembuh caak pacoeng tom naah, Anih angphat taak hanah, Simon capa, Juda Iskariot ih palung thungah taqawk mah toksak pae.
Ampa mah hmuen boih anih ban ah paek boeh, anih loe Sithaw khae hoi angzoh moe, Sithaw khaeah caeh han oh boeh, tiah Jesu mah panoek;
anih loe duembuh caakhaih ahmuen hoiah angthawk moe, angmah ih kahni to angkhring, pavawh to lak moe, kaeng ah angzaeng.
To pacoengah sabae thuk thungah tui a lawn moe, a hnukbang kaminawk ih khok to pasaeh pae, to pacoengah kaeng ah angzaeng ih pavawh hoiah a huk pae.
Simon Piter khaeah phak naah loe, Piter mah anih khaeah, Angraeng, ka khok nang pasaeh pae han maw? tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Vaihi ka sak ih tok hae na panoek thai mak ai; toe amzai ah ni na panoek vop tih,\wj* tiah a naa.

Piter mah anih khaeah, Ka khok hae natuek naah doeh na pasae mak ai, tiah a naa.  
 Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Kang pasae pae ai nahaeloe, kai ih kami ah na om mak ai,\wj* tiah a naa.
Simon Piter mah anih khaeah, Angraeng, ka khok khue ai, ka ban hoi ka lu doeh pasae ngala ah, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Tui amhluh kami loe khok khue ni pasaeh han angaih, kalah takpum loe ciim boeh: nangcae loe na ciim o, toe na ciim o boih ai,\wj* tiah a naa.

\s1 Jesu hoi Juda
Hae lok a thuih pacoengah, Jesu loe dawnrai hoiah oh; Loktang to, loktang ah, kang thuih o, \wj Nangcae thung ih kami maeto mah kai angphat taak tih,\wj* tiah a naa.

Juda tasa bang tacawt pacoengah, Jesu mah, \wj Kami Capa loe vaihi pakoeh ah oh boeh, Anih pongah Sithaw doeh pakoeh ah oh. \wj*
\wj Anih pongah Sithaw pakoeh ah om nahaeloe, anih pongah Sithaw Angmah to doeh pakoeh ah om ueloe, akra ai ah Anih to pakoeh roep tih boeh. \wj*

\x - \xo 13:33 \xt Jhn 7.34.\x*\wj Nawktanawk, nawnetta thungah ni nangcae khaeah ka om tih boeh. Nangcae mah nang pakrong o tih: toe Judahnawk khaeah ka thuih ih lok baktih toengah, vaihi roe kang thuih o: ka caehhaih ahmuen ah, nang zo o thai mak ai. \wj*

\s1 Piter kawng thuihcoek  
\r (Mathai 26.33-35; Marka 14.29-31; Luka 23.33-34)

Simon Piter mah anih khaeah, Angraeng, naa ah maw na caeh han? tiah a naa. Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Vaihi ka caehhaih ahmuen ah nang zo o thai mak ai, toe hae pacoengah ni nang zo o thai vop tih,\wj* tiah pathim pae.
Piter mah anih khaeah, Angraeng, tipongah vaihi kang zo o thai mak ai loe? Nang pongah ka hinghaih ka vah han, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Kai pongah na hinghaih na vah han maw? Loktang to, loktang ah, kang thuih, Aakhong ai na ah, vai thumto kai nang phat taak tih,\wj* tiah pathim pae.
\wj Poek anghmang o hmah: Sithaw to tang oh loe, kai doeh tang oh. \wj*
\wj Kam Pa im ah loe ohhaih ahmuen oh mangh: to tiah om ai nahaeloe, kang thuih o han boeh. Nangcae ohhaih ahmuen sak hanah ka caeh. \wj*
\wj Nangcae ohhaih ahmuen ka sak pacoengah, Kang zoh let moe, Ka ohhaih ahmuen ah, na oh o toeng hanah, kaimah khaeah kang lak o han. \wj*
\wj Ka caeh han ih ahmuen hoi loklam to na panoek o,\wj* tiah a naa.

\wj Kai nang panoek o boeh nahaeloe, kam Pa doeh na panoek o tih: vaihi hoi kamtong Anih to na panoek o moe, Anih to na hnuk o boeh,\wj* tiah a naa.
Philip mah anih khaeah, Angraeng, kaicae hanah Ampa to patuek ah, to tih nahaeloe kaicae han khawt boeh, tiah a naa.

Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Philip, atue kasawk ah nang hoi nawnto ka oh boeh, toe kai nang panoek ai vop maw? Kai hnu kami loe Ampa to hnuk boeh; kawbangah maw kaicae hanah Ampa to patuek ah, tiah na thuih? \wj*

\s1 Muithla patoehhaih
\wj Kai nang palung o nahaeloe, kang paek o ih loknawk to pakuem oh. \wj*
\wj Anih nangcae khaeah oh poe hanah, Pa khaeah lawk ka thuih han, Anih mah kalah Pathloepkung to na paek tih; \wj*

\wj loktang Muithla to na paek o tih; long mah Anih to hnu ai moe, panoek ai pongah, long mah Anih to talawk thai ai: toe nangcae mah loe Anih to na panoek o; Anih loe nangcae hoi nawnto oh, nangcae thungah doeh om tih. \wj*
\wj Pathloep ai ah kang caeh o taak mak ai: nangcae khaeah Kang zoh han. \wj*
\wj Akra ai ah long mah Kai hnu mak ai boeh; toe nangcae mah loe nang hnu o tih: Kai ka hing pongah, nangcae doeh na hing o toeng tih. \wj*
\wj To na niah loe Kam Pa khaeah Kai ka oh, Kai thungah nangcae na oh o moe, nangcae thungah Kai ka oh, tito na panoek o tih. \wj*
\wj Ka paek ih lok tahngai moe, pakuem kami loe, Kai palung kami ah oh: Kai palung kami loe Kam Pa mah palung tih, Kai mah anih to palung moe, kaimah roe anih khaeah kam tueng pae han.\wj*
To naah Judah (Judah Iskariot na ai) mah anih khaeah, Angraeng, tipongah kaicae khaeah nam tueng moe, long khaeah nam tueng ai loe? tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Kai palung kami loe, kai ih loknawk to pakuem tih: Kam Pa mah anih to palung tih, anih khaeah ka caeh o moe, anih hoi nawnto Kaimacae ohhaih im to ka sak o han. \wj*
\wj Kai palung ai kami mah loe ka thuih ih loknawk to pakuem ai: na thaih o ih lok loe kai ih lok na ai ni, Kai patoehkung Pa ih lok ni. \wj*
\wj Nangcae hoi nawnto ka oh naaah hae loknawk hae kang thuih o boeh. \wj*
\wj Toe kam Pa mah Kai ih ahmin hoiah patoeh han ih Pathloepkung, Kacai Muithla mah, nangcae han hmuennawk boih patuk tih, kang thuih o ih loknawk to panoeksak boih tih. \wj*
\wj Nangcae khaeah monghaih ka caehtaak, Ka monghaih to Kang paek o; long mah paek ih baktiah kang paek o ai. Poek anghmang o hmah loe, zii o hmah. \wj*

\wj Ka caeh moe, nangcae khaeah kang zoh let han, tiah kang thuih o ih lok to na thaih o boeh. Kai nang palung o nahaeloe, Pa khaeah ka caeh han boeh, tiah ka thuih pongah, nang hoe o tih: Pa loe kai pongah len kue. \wj*
\wj To hmuen pha ai naah kang thuih o coek boeh, to tiah ni to hmuen phak naah, na tang o tih. \wj*
\wj Long angraeng angzoh boeh pongah, hae pacoengah loe nangcae hoi lok kapop ah ka thui mak ai boeh, anih mah Kai kawbangah doeh na naa thai mak ai. \wj*
\wj Toe Ampa to ka palung moe, Ampa mah ang paek ih lok baktih toeng ah tok ka sak, tito long mah panoek tih. Angthawk oh, hae ahmuen hoiah caeh o si boeh,\wj* tiah a naa.
\wj Kai loe misurkung tangtang ah ka oh, Kam Pa loe takha tawnkung ah oh. \wj*
\wj Anih loe kai ih athaih kathai ai tanghangnawk to pakhruk: athaih kathai tanghangnawk loe athaih aep hanah, tanghangnawk to atlik pae. \wj*
\wj Nangcae loe kang thuih o ih lok hoiah vaihi na ciim o boeh. \wj*

\wj Kai khaeah om o poe ah, Kai doeh nangcae khaeah ka oh poe han. Misurkung ah angpeh ai tanghang loe, angmah koehah athaih athai thai ai; Kai ah na om o ai nahaeloe, athaih na thai o thai mak ai. \wj*

\wj Kai loe misurkung ah ka oh, nangcae loe tanghang ah na oh o: Kai ai ah loe tidoeh na sah o thai ai pongah, Kai ah kaom kami loe, Kai doeh anih khaeah ka oh, to tiah om kami loe athaih paroeai athaih. \wj*
\wj Kai ah kaom ai kami loe, kangqo tanghang baktiah tasa bangah vah o ving; kaminawk mah tanghang to akhuih o moe, hmai thungah vah o, nihcae loe hmai mah kangh. \wj*
\wj Kai ah na oh o moe, ka lok nangcae thungah om nahaeloe, na koeh o ih hmuen to hni oh, nangcae hanah sah pae tih. \wj*
\wj Kam Pa loe athaih kapop ah na thaih o haih rang hoiah pakoeh ah oh; to tiah ni ka hnukbang kami ah na om o tih. \wj*
\wj Pa mah Ang palung baktih toengah, Kang palung o toeng: Kai amlunghaih ah om oh. \wj*
\wj Kam Pa mah paek ih loknawk to ka pakuem moe, Anih amlunghaih ah ka oh baktih toengah, Kang paek ih loknawk to na pakuem o nahaeloe, Kai amlunghaih ah na om o tih. \wj*
\wj Kang hoehaih nangcae khaeah oh moe, nang hoe o haih akoep thai hanah, hae loknawk hae kang thuih o. \wj*
\x - \xo 15:12 \xt Jhn 13.34; 15.17; 1 Jhn 3.23; 2 Jhn 1.5.\x*\wj Kang palung o baktih toengah, nangcae doeh maeto hoi maeto amlung oh, hae loe kang paek o ih lok ah oh. \wj*
\wj Kami maeto mah ampuinawk hanah a hinghaih paek khoek to amlunghaih pongah kalen kue amlunghaih to om ai boeh. \wj*
\wj Kang thuih o ih lok baktiah na sak o nahaeloe, Kai ih ampui ah na oh o. \wj*

\wj Angmah ih angraeng mah sak ih tok to tamna mah panoek ai pongah, vaihi hoi kamtong tamna, tiah kang kawk o mak ai boeh; Kam Pa khae hoi ka thaih ih loknawk to nangcae khaeah kam tuengsak boeh pongah, ampui, tiah ni kang kawk o boeh. \wj*

\wj Nangcae mah kai nang qoi o ai, Kai mah ni nangcae to kang qoih, na caeh o moe, athaih na thaih o pacoengah, nangcae ih athaih to oh poe hanah, tok kang paek o: to naah Kai ih ahmin hoiah Pa khaeah hni kami loe, Anih mah nangcae hanah paek tih. \wj*

\wj Maeto hoi maeto nam lung o hanah, hae loknawk hae kang paek o.\wj*   
\s1 Long mah hnukmahaih
\wj Long mah nangcae hnuma nahaeloe, nangcae hnuma ai naah Kai ni ang hnukma, tito panoek oh. \wj*

\wj Long kami ah na oh o nahaeloe, angmah ih kami ah na oh o pongah, long mah nangcae to palung tih: toe nangcae loe long kami ah na om o ai, long thung hoiah kang qoih o boeh pongah, long mah nangcae to hnukma. \wj*

\x - \xo 15:20 \xt Mathai 10.24; Luk 6.40; Jhn 13.16.\x*\wj Kang thuih o ih lok to poek oh, Tamna loe angmah ih angraeng pongah len kue ai. Nihcae mah Kai pacaekthlaek nahaeloe, nangcae doeh pacaekthlaek o toeng tih; nihcae mah Ka thuih ih lok pakuem o nahaeloe, nangcae mah thuih o ih lok doeh nihcae mah pakuem o toeng tih. \wj*
\wj Nihcae mah Kai patoehkung Anih to panoek o ai pongah, Kai ih ahmin pongah nihcae mah hae hmuennawk hae nangcae nuiah sah o tih. \wj*
\wj Kai kang zo ai moe, nihcae khaeah ka thui ai nahaeloe, nihcae loe zaehaih tawn o mak ai: toe vaihi loe angmacae zaehaih to angphat o thai mak ai boeh. \wj*
\wj Kai hnuma kami loe Kam Pa doeh hnukma. \wj*

\wj Kalah kaminawk mah sah ai ih toknawk to nihcae salakah ka sah ai nahaeloe, nihcae loe zaehaih tawn o mak ai: toe vaihi loe ka sak ih toknawk nihcae mah hnuk o boeh pongah, nihcae mah Kai hoi Kam Pa to hnukma o. \wj*
\x - \xo 15:25 \xt Saam 35.19; 69.4.\x*\wj Toe angmacae ih kaalok pongah, Tidoeh na ai ah nihcae mah Kai ang hnukma o, tiah tarik ih lok to akoep thai han ih ni hae tiah oh. \wj*
\wj Pa khae hoiah kang patoeh han ih Pathloepkung, Pa khae hoi tacawt, loktang Muithla to angzoh naah, Anih mah Kai kawng to taphong tih. \wj*
\wj Nangcae doeh tangsuek na hoi Kai khaeah na oh o pongah, Kai hnukung ah na om o toeng tih.\wj*
\wj Palung na boeng o han ai ah, hae loknawk hae kang thuih o. \wj*
\wj Nihcae mah Sineko thung hoiah na haek o tih: ue, nangcae hum kami mah, kai loe Sithaw ih tok ni ka sak, tiah poekhaih atue to pha tih. \wj*
\wj Nihcae mah Pa hoi Kai to panoek o ai pongah, hae baktih toknawk nangcae nuiah sah o tih. \wj*

\wj To baktih atue phak naah kang thuih o ih loknawk na panoek o thai hanah, kang thuih o coek boeh.\wj*   
\s1 Muithla toksakhaih
\wj Vaihi loe kai patoehkung Anih khaeah Ka caeh han boeh; mi mah doeh naa ah maw na caeh han? tiah nang dueng o ai. \wj*
\wj Nangcae khaeah hae tiah kang thuih o pongah, palung na set o. \wj*

\wj Toe loktang kang thuih o; Ka caeh ving hae nangcae hanah hoih: Ka caeh ving ai nahaeloe, Pathloepkung nangcae khaeah angzo mak ai; toe ka caeh ving nahaeloe, Anih to nangcae khaeah kang patoeh han. \wj*
\wj Anih angzoh naah anih mah long zaehaih, toenghaih hoi lokcaekhaih to panoeksak tih: \wj*
\wj nihcae mah Kai tang o ai pongah, zaehaih to amtuengsak tih; \wj*
\wj kam Pa khaeah Ka caeh moe, kai nang hnuk o han ai boeh pongah, toenghaih to amtuengsak tih; \wj*
\wj long angraeng to lokcaek boeh pongah, lokcaekhaih to amtuengsak tih. \wj*
\wj Nangcae khae thuih han ih lok oh mang vop, toe vaihi loe na panoek o thai ai vop. \wj*

\wj Toe loktang Muithla, Anih to angzoh naah loe, anih mah loktang boih to na patuk o tih: anih loe angmah koehah lokthui mak ai; anih mah loe a thaih ih lok to ni thui tih: to pacoengah angzo han koi hmuennawk to nangcae hanah patuek tih. \wj*
\wj Anih mah kai ih hmuen to la ueloe, nangcae hanah patuek tih, to tiah Anih mah Kai to pakoeh tih. \wj*

\wj Pa mah tawnh ih hmuen boih loe Kai ih ni: to pongah ni anih mah Kai ih hmuen to la ueloe, nangcae hanah patuek tih, tiah ka thuih.\wj*   
\s1 Palungsethaih to anghoehaih oh
\wj Pa khaeah Ka caeh han boeh pongah, akra ai ah nangcae mah Kai nang hnu o mak ai boeh: akra ai ah Kai nang hnu o let tih,\wj* tiah a naa.

A hnukbang thoemto\wj kaminawk mah, Pa khaeah Ka caeh han boeh pongah, akra ai ah Kai nang hnu o mak ai boeh: akra ai ah Kai nang hnu o let tih,\wj* tiah nang thuih ih lok loe tih thuih koehhaih ih maw?
Akra ai ah, tiah a thuih ih lok loe tih thuih koehhaih ih maw? A thuih koehhaih lok a panoek o thai ai, tiah maeto hoi maeto a thuih o.

Anih khaeah hae lok dueng han a koeh o, tiah Jesu mah panoek naah, \wj nihcae khaeah, Akra ai ah Kai nang hnu o mak ai boeh: akra ai ah Kai nang hnu o let tih, tiah ka thuih ih lok pongah maw maeto hoi maeto lok nang dueng o? \wj*
\wj Loktang to, loktang ah, kang thuih o, Long palung anghoe naah, nangcae palung na sae o ueloe, na qah o tih: palung na sae o tih, toe palung na set o haih to anghoehaih ah angcoeng tih. \wj*
\wj Nongpata loe zokpomh, caa tapenhaih atue phak boeh pongah, palung a set: toe nawkta tapen pacoengah loe long ah kami maeto tapen boeh pongah, anih mah patangkhanghaih to pahnet moe, anghoe. \wj*
\wj To baktih toengah vaihi palung na set o, toe kang hnuk o let naah loe, palung anghoehaih na tawn o tih, nang hoe o haih loe mi mah doeh nangcae khae hoi la thai mak ai. \wj*
\wj To na niah loe Kai khaeah tidoeh nang hni o mak ai boeh. Loktang to, loktang ah, kang thuih o, Kai ih ahmin hoi Pa khaeah na hnik o ih hmuen boih Anih mah na paek o tih. \wj*
\wj Nangcae mah vaihi khoek to Kai ih ahmin hoiah tidoeh na hni o ai vop: nangcae anghoehaih akoep thai hanah, hni oh, na hnu o tih. \wj*
\wj Patahhaih lok hoiah ni hae loknawk hae kang thuih o: toe patahhaih lok patoh ai ah, nangcae khaeah Pa kawng kamtueng ah thuihaih atue to pha tih. \wj*
\wj To na niah loe Ka hmin hoiah nang hni o tih: nangcae han Pa khaeah kang hnik pae o han, tiah ka thuih koehhaih ih na ai ni. \wj*
\wj Kai loe Sithaw khae hoiah ni kang zoh, tiah na tang o moe, kai nang palung o pongah, Pa angmah roe nangcae to palung. \wj*
\wj Kai loe Pa khae hoiah tacawt moe, long ah kang zoh: long hae Ka caehtaak moe, Pa khaeah Ka caeh let han,\wj* tiah a naa.
A hnukbang kaminawk mah anih khaeah, Khenah, vaihi loe patahhaih lok hoi thui ai ah, kamtueng ah na thuih boeh.
Hmuennawk boih na panoek, mi mah doeh nang khaeah lokdueng han angaih ai boeh, tiah vaihi ka panoek o boeh: hae kawng pongah nang loe Sithaw khae hoiah ni nang zoh, tiah ka tang o, tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Vaihi loe na tang o boeh maw? \wj*

\wj Khenah, nam praek o phang tih, nangmacae im ah na cawn o ueloe, kai nang caeh o taak suthaih atue to pha tih, ue, vaihi roe phak boeh: toe kai loe kaimah buengah ka om ai, Pa loe kai hoi nawnto oh. \wj*
\wj Kai ah monghaih na tawnh o thai hanah, hae hmuennawk hae kang thuih o. Long nuiah raihaih na tong o tih: toe mawn o hmah, long hae ka pazawk boeh,\wj* tiah a naa.
Jesu mah hae loknawk thuih pacoengah, van ah doeng tahang moe, \wj Pa, atue mah phak boeh; na Capa mah Ang pakoeh hanah, na Capa hae pakoeh lai ah, tiah lawkthuih. \wj*
\wj Capa han na paek ih paroeai kaminawk khaeah, Capa mah dungzan hinghaih to paek hanah, kaminawk boih ukhaih to Capa khaeah na paek boeh. \wj*
\wj Nihcae mah, Na patoeh ih Jesu Kri hoi nang khue ni Sithaw tangtang, tiah panoekhaih loe dungzan hinghaih ah oh. \wj*
\wj Sak han nang paek ih tok to ka pacoeng boeh: long nuiah na hmin ka pakoeh boeh. \wj*

\wj Aw Pa, long om ai naah nang khae hoi ka tawnh ih lensawkhaih hoiah, vaihi nang mah hoi nawnto na pakoeh lai ah.\wj*   
\s1 Hnukbang kaminawk han lawkthuihaih
\wj Long hoiah nang paek ih kaminawk khaeah na hmin to kam tuengsak boeh: nihcae loe nang ih kami ah ni oh o, nihcae to kai hanah nang paek; nihcae mah na lok to pakuem o boeh. \wj*
\wj Nang paek ih hmuennawk boih loe nang ih ni, tiah vaihi nihcae mah panoek o boeh. \wj*

\wj Nang paek ih loknawk to nihcae khaeah ka thuih, nihcae mah lok to talawk o boeh, Kai loe nang khae hoiah ni kang zoh, tiah nihcae mah kamtueng ah panoek o boeh, Kai loe nang mah ni patoeh, tiah a tang o boeh. \wj*
\wj Nihcae loe nang ih kami ah oh o pongah, nang paek ih kaminawk hanah, lawk ka thuih pae, long hanah lawk ka thui ai. \wj*
\wj Ka tawnh ih hmuennawk boih loe nang ih ni, nang ih hmuennawk boih doeh Kai ih ni; nihcae rang hoiah kai loe pakoeh ah ka oh. \wj*

\wj Kai loe vaihi long ah ka om ai boeh, toe nihcae loe long nuiah oh o vop, Kai loe nang khaeah kang zoh han boeh. Ciimcai Pa, Nang hoi Kai loe maeto ah a oh hoi baktih toengah, nang paek ih nihcae doeh, maeto ah a oh o thai hanah, na hmin hoiah khenzawn ah. \wj*

\x - \xo 17:12 \xt Saam 41.9; Jhn 13.18.\x*\wj Nihcae hoi nawnto long ah ka oh naah, nihcae to na hmin hoiah ka khetzawn: nang paek ih kaminawk to ka khetzawn boeh, toe Cabu akoep thai hanah, kanghmaa kangtaa capa thuih ai ah loe, maeto doeh anghmaa o ai. \wj*
\wj Vaihi nang khaeah kang zoh han boeh; Kang hoehaih hoiah nihcae koi o thai hanah, long ah hae loknawk hae ni ka thuih. \wj*
\wj Nihcae khaeah na lok to ka paek boeh; Kai loe long kami ah ka om ai baktih toengah, nihcae doeh long kami ah om o ai, to pongah long mah nihcae to hnukma. \wj*
\wj Long hoiah nihcae lak ving han lawk ka thui ai; kasae hmuen thung hoiah nihcae khetzawn han ih ni lawk ka thuih. \wj*
\wj Long ih hmuen ah ka om ai baktih toengah, nihcae doeh long ih hmuen ah om o ai. \wj*
\wj Loktang na lok hoiah nihcae to ciimcaisak ah: na lok loe loktang ah oh. \wj*
\wj Long nuiah kai nang patoeh baktih toengah, nihcae doeh long nuiah ka patoeh toeng. \wj*

\wj Nihcae loktang lok hoiah ciimcai o thai hanah, nihcae pongah kaimah hoi kaimah to ciimcai ah ka oh.\wj*   
\s1 Tang caanawk han lawkthuihaih
\wj Nihcae han khue lawk ka thui ai, nihcae mah thuih o ih lok rang hoiah Kai tang han kaom kaminawk hanah doeh lawk ka thuih; \wj*

\wj Kai loe nang mah ni patoeh, tiah long mah tang thai hanah, nihcae doeh aicae khaeah maeto ah oh o toeng, Pa, Kai thungah na oh moe, Kai nang thungah ka oh baktih toengah, nihcae boih maeto ah oh o thai hanah, lawk ka thuih. \wj*
\wj Aicae maeto ah a oh o baktih toengah, nihcae doeh maeto ah oh o thaih moe, \wj*

\wj Kai nihcae thungah Ka oh moe, nang Kai thungah na oh, Kai nang patoeh moe, Kai nang palung baktih toengah, nihcae doeh na palung toeng, tiah long mah panoek moe, nihcae maeto ah oh o thai hanah, nihcae khaeah nang paek ih lensawkhaih to ka paek boeh. \wj*
\wj Pa, long om ai na hoiah boeh Kai nang palung boeh, nang paek ih ka lensawkhaih nihcae mah hnuk o thai hanah, nang paek ih kaminawk doeh ka ohhaih ahmuen ah kai hoi nawnto ohsak han ka koeh. \wj*
\wj Aw katoeng Pa, long mah nang to panoek ai: toe Kaimah loe kang panoek; Kai loe nang mah ni patoeh, tito hae kaminawk mah panoek o boeh. \wj*
\wj Nihcae khaeah na hmin ka taphong boeh, nang palunghaih nihcae khaeah oh moe, Kai nihcae thungah ka oh thai hanah, na hmin to ka taphong han vop,\wj* tiah a thuih.

\s1 Jesu angphat taakhaih hoi naehhaih  
\r (Mathai 26.47-56; Marka 14.43-50; Luka 22.47-53)
Jesu lawkthuih pacoengah, a hnukbang kaminawk hoi nawnto Kidron tava yaeh ah caeh o, a hnukbang kaminawk hoi vapui yaeh ah kaom takha thungah akun o.
Jesu loe to ahmuen ah a hnukbang kaminawk hoi caeh o toepsoep pongah, Anih angphat taak Juda mah doeh to ahmuen to panoek toeng.
Juda mah kalen koek qaima, Farasinawk mah patoeh ih misatuh kaminawk to takha thungah angzoh haih, nihcae loe hmaithaw, hmaiim, maiphawnawk hoiah ang zoh o.
Jesu loe a nuiah pha han koi hmuennawk to panoek boih pongah, hmaa bangah caeh moe, nihcae khaeah, \wj mi maw na pakrong o,\wj* tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Nazareth Jesu, tiah a naa o. Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Anih loe Kai hae boeh ni,\wj* tiah a naa. Anih angphat taak Juda doeh nihcae hoi nawnto angdoet toeng.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Anih loe Kai hae boeh ni,\wj* tiah thuih pacoengah, nihcae loe hnukbang angnawn o moe, long ah amtimh o.
To pacoengah Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Mimaw na pakrong o?\wj* tiah dueng let. Nihcae mah, Nazareth Jesu, tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah, \wj Anih loe Kai hae boeh ni, tiah kang thuih o boeh na ai maw: kai nang pakrong o nahaeloe, hae kaminawk hae caeh o sak ah,\wj* tiah a naa.
Nang paek ih kaminawk maeto doeh kang hmasak ai, tiah a thuih ih lok akoep han ih ni hae tiah a thuih.
To naah Simon Piter mah, angmah ih sumsen to aphongh moe, kalen koek qaima tamna ih bangtang naa to takroek pae pat. Tamna ih ahmin loe Malkuh.

\x - \xo 18:11 \xt Mathai 26.39; Mark 14.36; Luk 22.42.\x*Jesu mah Piter khaeah, \wj Na sumsen to tabu thungah pacaeng ah: Kam Pa mah ang paek ih boengloeng hae Ka nae mak ai maw?\wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Jesu naeh o
To naah misatuh kaminawk hoi Judahnawk zaehoikung angraengnawk mah Jesu to naeh o moe, taoengh o,
Anih to Anna khaeah caeh o haih hmaloe, anih loe Kaiapha ih amsae ah oh moe, to na saning ah kalen koek qaima ah oh.
\x - \xo 18:14 \xt Jhn 11.49,50.\x*Kaiapha loe kaminawk hanah kami maeto duek to hoih kue, tiah Judahnawk khaeah thui kami ah oh.

Simon Piter hoi a hnukbang kalah kami maeto loe Jesu hnukah bang hoi: to a hnukbang kami loe kalen koek qaima hoiah angmat hoi pongah, anih loe Jesu hoi nawnto kalen koek qaima imthung ah akunh.   
\s1 Piter mah Jesu angphat taak  
\r (Mathai 26.69-70; Marka 14.66-68; Luka 22.63-71)

Toe Piter loe tasa bang ih thok taengah angdoet sut. Kalen koek qaima hoi angmat a hnukbang kalah kami maeto loe tasa bangah tacawt, khongkha toep nongpata hoiah lok apaeh hoi pacoengah, Piter to imthung ah akunsak.
Khongkha toep nongpata mah Piter khaeah, Nang doeh hae kami hnukbang kaminawk thung ih maeto ah na oh toeng na ai maw? tiah a naa. To naah Piter mah, Kai na ai ni, tiah a naa.

Angqai pongah, tamnanawk hoi toksah angraengnawk loe hmaitik o moe, hmai angawt o: Piter doeh nihcae khaeah angdoet moe, hmai angawt toeng.   
\s1 Kalen koek qaima mah lokdueng
Kalen koek qaima mah Jesu khaeah a hnubang kaminawk hoi anih mah patuk ih hmuennawk kawng to dueng.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Kai loe long khaeah kamtuengah lok ka thuih; Judahnawk amkhueng o haih sineko hoi tempul ah patukhaih ka sak toepsoep; tih lok doeh tamquta ah ka thui vai ai. \wj*
\wj Tih han ih kai lok nang dueng loe? Ka thuih ih lok thaih kaminawk khaeah dueng oh, khenah, nihcae khaeah tih lok maw ka thuih, ka thuih ih lok loe nihcae mah panoek o.\wj*
To tiah lok a thuih pacoengah, to ahmuen ah angdoe toksah angraeng maeto mah Jesu to tabaeng, kalen koek qaima ih lok to hae tiah maw na pathim? tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Kasae ka thuih nahaeloe, ka sethaih to na thui ah: loktang lok ni ka thuih, tikhoe kai nang tabaeng loe?\wj* tiah a naa.

To pacoengah Anna mah anih to taoengh moe, kalen koek qaima, Kaiapha khaeah patoeh.   
\s1 Piter mah angphat taak let

Simon Piter loe angdoet moe, hmai angawt. To naah nihcae mah anih khaeah, Nang doeh anih hnukbang kaminawk thung ih maeto toeng na ai maw? tiah a naa o. Anih mah angphat taak, kai na ai ni, tiah a naa.
Kalen koek qaima ih tamna maeto ah kaom, Piter mah naa takroek pae pat ih tamna ih canawk maeto mah, nang loe Anih hoi nawnto takha thungah kaom kang hnuk ih kami na ai maw? tiah a naa.

Toe Piter mah, angphat taak let bae: akra ai ah aakhong roep.   
\s1 Pilat hmaa ah Jusu  
\r (Mathai 27.11-18,20-23; Marka 15.2-5; Luka 23.2-3,18-25)

To pongah Pilat mah nihcae khaeah caeh moe, Tih zae nethaih maw oh moe, hae kami hae kai khaeah nang hoih o? tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Sethaih sah kami ah om ai nahaeloe, anih hae nang khaeah kang hoi o tih maw? tiah a naa o.

Pilat mah nihcae khaeah, Anih hae hoi oh loe, nangmacae ih daan baktiah lokcaek oh, tiah a naa. Toe Judahnawk mah anih khaeah, Kaicae loe mi kawbaktih doeh hum thaihaih daan ka tawn o ai, tiah a naa o.

 Jesu mah, \wj Kai loe Siangpahrang ah ka oh, tiah na thuih ih lok loe amsoem. Kai loe loktang hnukung ah oh han ih ni, ka tapen moe, long ah kang zoh. Mi kawbaktih doeh loktang ah kaom kami mah loe, ka lok to tahngaih,\wj* tiah pathim pae.

Pilat mah anih khaeah, Loktang loe timaw? tiah a naa. Anih mah hae lok thuih pacoengah, Judahnawk khaeah tasa bangah caeh let moe, nihcae khaeah, Anih nuiah zaehaih tidoeh ka hnu ai, tiah a naa.   
\s1 Barabba zuengah lokcaek o
Toe nangmacae ih atawk baktih toengah misong loihhaih poih ah kami maeto kang prawt pae o han oh, to pongah Judah Siangpahrang hae kang prawt pae o han maw? tiah a naa.
To naah nihcae boih mah, Hae kami na ai, Barabba to prawt ah, tiah a hangh o. Barabba loe mingcah ah oh.
To naah Pilat mah Jesu to lak moe, a boh.
Misatuh kaminawk mah soekhring lumuek sak pae o moe, a lu ah angmuek o sak, nihcae mah kahni kamling to angkhuk o sak,

\s1 Pilat lokcaekhaih
Jesu loe soekhring lumuek to angmuek moe, kahni kamling angkhuk pacoengah, tasa bangah angzoh. Pilat mah nihcae khaeah, Kami hae khen oh! tiah a naa.

Kalen koek qaima hoi toksah angraengnawk mah Anih to hnuk o naah, Anih to thinglam pongah takhing ah! Anih to thinglam pongah takhing ah! tiah hang o. Pilat mah nihcae khaeah, A nuiah zaehaih ka hnu ai pongah, Anih to nangmacae mah hoi oh loe, takhing oh, tiah a naa.
To naah Judahnawk mah anih khaeah, Kaicae loe daan ka tawnh o, angmah hoi angmah Sithaw Capa ah angsak pongah, kaimacae ih daan baktih toengah Anih loe duek han oh, tiah pathim pae o.
Pilat mah to lok to thaih naah, a zit aep:
lokcaekhaih imthung ah caeh let moe, Jesu khaeah, Naa hoiah maw nang zoh? tiah a naa. Toe Jesu mah lok pathim pae ai.
Pilat mah anih khaeah, Lok nang pathim mak ai maw? Nang thinglam pong takhing thaih kami hoi loisak thaih kami ah ka oh, tito na panoek ai maw? tiah a naa.
Jesu mah, \wj Ranui bang hoiah na paek ai nahaeloe, ka nuiah sakthaihaih tidoeh na tawn mak ai: to pongah nang khaeah Kai paek kami loe kalen kue zaehaih to tawnh, \wj* tiah a naa.

To naa hoi kamtong Pilat mah Anih loisak hanah loklam to pakrong: toe Judahnawk mah, Hae kami na loisak nahaeloe, nang loe Caesar ih ampui na ai boeh ni: mi kawbaktih doeh angmah hoi angmah siangpahrang ah angsah kami loe Caesar ih misa ni, tiah a naa o.

Toe nihcae mah, Anih to hoi ving ah, anih to hoi ving ah, anih to thinglam pongah takhing ah, tiah hang o. Pilat mah nihcae khaeah, Nangcae ih Siangphrang hae thinglam pongah ka takhing han maw? tiah a naa. To naah kalen koek qaima mah, Caesar ai ah loe siangpahrang ka tawn o ai, tiah pathim pae.

To pacoengah Pilat mah Jesu to thinglam pong takhing hanah nihcae ban ah paek. Nihcae mah Jesu to lak o moe, a caeh o haih.   
\s1 Jesu takhinghaih  
\r (Mathai 27.33-44; Marka 15.22-32; Luka 23.33-43)
Anih loe angmah ih thinglam to aput moe, luhuh (Hebru lok hoiah Golgotha,) tiah thuih ih ahmuen ah caeh.
To ahmuen ah nihcae mah anih to thinglam pongah takhing o, banqoi bangah maeto bantang bangah maeto, kami hnetto anih hoi nawnto takhing o moe, Jesu loe a um ah takhing o.
Pilat mah, NAZARETH JESU, JUDAHNAWK IH SIANGPAHRANG, tiah angmathaih ca tarik pacoengah, thinglam pongah takhing.
Jesu thinglam nuiah takhinghaih ahmuen loe vangpui hoiah zoidaek: to ih ca loe Hebrew, Grik, Latin lok hoiah tarik pongah, paroeai Judah kaminawk mah kroek o.
Judahnawk ih kalen koek qaima mah Pailat khaeah, Judah Siangpahrang, tiah tarik hmah, hae kami mah, Kai loe Judah Siangpahrang ah ka oh, tiah thuih, tiah tarik hanah a thuih pae.
Pilat mah, Ka tarik pacoeng boeh loe, tarik pacoeng ah ni oh boeh, tiah a naa.

Misatuh kaminawk mah, Jesu thinglam pong takhing o pacoengah, anih ih kahni to lak o moe, palito ah tapraek o, misatoep kaminawk mah maeto kangbae ah lak o boih; anih ih kahni doeh lak pae o: to kahni loe lu hoi khok khoek to kasawkah sak ih kahniah oh pongah, huihhaih ahmaa to om ai.

\r (Mathai 27.48-50; Marka 15.36-37; Luka 23.36)
\x - \xo 19:28 \xt Saam 69.21; 22.15.\x*To pacoengah loe Jesu mah Cabu lok akoep hanah, hmuen boih sak pacoeng boeh, tiah panoek naah, \wj Tui kang haeh,\wj* tiah a thuih.

Jesu mah misurtui kathaw to pataeng pacoengah, \wj Pacoeng boeh,\wj* tiah thuih, to pacoengah luthuk moe, a hinghaih to qui apet.   
\s1 Jesu ih panak thun o

To na ni loe amprikcaihaih niah oh, (Sabbath ni loe kasang niah oh), to pongah Sabbath niah thinglam pongah kami qok oh han om ai, Judahnawk loe nihcae ih khok to khaeh moe, a qok to lak hanah, Pilat khaeah caeh o moe, a hnik o.
Misatuh kaminawk angzoh o moe, anih hoi nawnto takhing ih hmaloe koek kami maeto ih khok to khaeh pae o pacoengah, kalah maeto ih khok doeh khaeh pae o.
Toe Jesu khae phak o naah, Anih loe duek boeh pongah, Anih ih khok loe khaek pae o ai.

\s1 Jesu aphum o  
\r (Mathai 27.57-61; Marka 15.42-47; Luka 23.50-56)

To pacoengah Judahnawk zit pongah, tamquta hoi Jesu hnukbang kami, Arimathea avang ih Joseph mah, Pilat khaeah, Jesu ih qok lak hanah a hnik: Pilat mah lak han paek pongah, anih loe caeh moe, Jesu ih qok to lak.

\s1 Jesu angthawk lethaih  
\r (Mathai 28.1-8; Marka 16.1-8; Luka 24.1-10)
Meri Magdalene loe, ni sarihto thung hmaloe koek ni, khawnthaw khoving ah taprong ah caeh, to naah kang khoe ving taprong kraenghaih thlung to a hnuk.
To naah Simon Piter hoi Jesu mah palung ih, kalah a hnukbang khaeah cawnh moe, nihnik khaeah, Taprong thung hoiah Angraeng to lak o ving boeh, naa ah maw a suek o, tito ka panoek ai, tiah a naa.
Nihnik loe nawnto cawnh hoi: toe kalah a hnukbang maeto mah Piter to poengtaak ving moe, taprong ah phak hmaloe.
Anih mah takhum tathuk moe, a thungah khet naah, kahni khue kaom to a hnuk; toe anih loe a thungah akun ai.
To naah a cawnhtaak ih Simon Piter to phak, taprong thungah akun naah, kahni khue kaom,
a lu taengah suek ih pavawh loe kahni hoi nawnto om ai, angmah koehah ahmuen maeto ah nawnto amkhraep to a hnuk.
Taprong ah pha hmaloe, kalah a hnukbang doeh a thungah akun toeng, anih mah hnuk naah, tanghaih to tawnh.
Anih loe duekhaih thung hoi angthawk let tih, tiah thuih ih Cabu lok to nihcae mah panoek o ai vop.

To pacoengah a hnukbang kami hnik loe angma hnik im ah caeh hoi let.   
\s1 Meri Magdalene khaeah Jesu amtueng  
\r (Marka 16.9-11)
Toe Meri loe taprong taengah angdoet moe, qah: anih loe qah hoi takhum tathuk moe, taprong thungah khet,
to naah Jesu qok pasonghaih ahmuen ah, lu bangah maeto, akhok bangah maeto kanghnu, kanglung van kami hnik to a hnuk.
Nihnik mah anih khaeah, Nongpata tikhoe na qah loe? tiah a naa hoi. Anih mah nihnik khaeah, Ka Angraeng nihcae mah lak o ving boeh, anih loe naa ah maw a suek o, tito ka panoek ai, tiah a naa.
To tiah a thuih pacoengah, anih loe hnukbang ah anghae, to naah kangdoe Jesu to a hnuk, toe Jesu ni, tito anih mah panoek ai.

Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Nongpata, tikhoe na qah loe? Mi maw na pakrong?\wj* tiah a naa. To kami loe takha tawnkung mue, tiah a poek pongah, anih khaeah, Patukkung, anih ih qok na lak nahaeloe, anih to naa ah maw na suek na thui ah, ka caeh moe, anih to ka lak han, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Meri,\wj* tiah a naa. To naah Meri mah angqoi moe, Anih khaeah Rabboni! (thuih koehhaih loe Patukkung, tih haih ih ni) tiah a naa.

Jesu mah nongpata khaeah, \wj Na sui hmah; Pa khaeah Ka caeh ai vop: toe kam nawkamyanawk khaeah caeh ah loe, nihcae khaeah, Kam Pa hoi nangcae ih Ampa; Ka Sithaw hoi nangcae ih Sithaw khaeah ka caeh han boeh, tiah a thuih, tiah thui paeh,\wj* tiah a naa.

To naah Meri Magdalene loe caeh moe, a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah, Angraeng to ka hnuk boeh, Anih mah ni hae hmuennawk hae ang thuih, tiah a naa.   
\s1 A hnukbangnawk khaeah Jesu amtueng  
\r (Matthai 28.16-20; Marka 16.14-18; Luka 24.36-46)

Ni sarihto thung ih ni hmaloe koek, to na ni duembang ah a hnukbang kaminawk amkhueng o, Judahnawk a zit o pongah thok to khah o, to naah Jesu angzoh moe, nihcae um ah angdoet pae, nihcae khaeah, \wj Nangcae khaeah monghaih om nasoe,\wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah to tiah thuih pacoengah, A ban hoi panak to nihcae khaeah patuek pae. Angraeng to a hnuk o naah, a hnukbang kaminawk poeknawm o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Nangcae khaeah monghaih om nasoe: Kam Pa mah ang patoeh baktih toengah, nangcae doeh kang patoeh,\wj* tiah a naa.
To tiah a thuih pacoengah, nihcae to anghah thuih moe, nihcae khaeah, Kacai Muithla talawk oh, tiah a naa.

Jesu mah hae Cabu thungah tarik ai ih, kalah paroeai angmathaih doeh a hnukbang kaminawk hmaa ah sak pae:

\s1 Jesu mah Piter lokdueng
